title: AI Forex YouTube Channel Manager
description:
We're looking to hire someone to help us build a successful AI YouTube channel from scratch, covering Forex market analysis. This is part of a growing network of AI channels, and we already run other businesses generating six figures a month, so this isn't a project we're hoping works out. We know the model works, we just need the right person to run it daily and make it their own.



You won't just be an employee here. We'll personally teach you, one on one, how to build a brand from the ground up, the AI tools, the content strategy, all of it, while you earn a real salary and get in early on something with genuinely insane growth potential.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Each day you'll dig into the biggest Forex moves and turn it into a script, using our framework along with your own eye for what actually matters. You'll turn that script into a full video using our AI voice and video tools, no camera and no studio needed. You'll edit it, put together a thumbnail that actually gets clicks, and get it live every single day. You'll jump into the comments to build a real community around the channel, and you're encouraged to pitch your own ideas for hooks and formats, since we're building this together, not just handing you a script to execute.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



You're genuinely into Forex or trading, not intimidated by new tools (we'll train you on everything AI, you just need to be quick to pick it up), and you write clean, sharp English. This needs to be your main gig, not something squeezed in between three other jobs. Once you're trained, we trust you to run with it, with weekly check ins and no micromanaging.



REQUIREMENTS



You're available full time and reliable enough that "every single day" actually means every single day, including a rotating weekend day. You'll need a solid internet connection, a quiet spot to record and review audio, and a laptop that can handle basic video editing.



COMPENSATION



Base salary is $1,000 to $1,500 a month depending on experience, plus real performance bonuses on top. We're not a startup hoping to make it one day, we're already running six figure a month businesses, so if this channel takes off, you take off with it.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
FastAid is a first aid kits and consumables designer, importer and wholesaler based in Sydney, Australia. We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Graphic Designer to join our fast growing, friendly and vibrant team full time.



This is a full-time work from home role, with generous salary inclusive of 20 days annual leave p.a., detailed training and on-boarding, along with annual visits to our office Sydney, Australia paid for.



The Graphic Designer is responsible for bringing FastAid's brand to life visually, delivering high-quality, on-brand artwork and creative assets across both print and digital media. Creating and maintaining product artwork, preparing production-ready files, and supporting the marketing team with design for campaigns and collateral — always with an unbeatable eye for detail and consistency with our brand guidelines. Also responsible for editing and producing video content for marketing and product use, and keeping all design and video assets clean and methodically filed.



Expert-level skills in the Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) are essential, with experience in video editing and production (e.g. Premiere Pro / After Effects) highly regarded. Must have a strong understanding of design and brand principles, and the ability to work to deadlines across multiple concurrent requests.



The role consists of four key areas;



1. Product artwork

2. Production-ready file preparation

3. Marketing design support

4. Video editing and production



Key attributes required:



- Always positive and energetic, friendly, and down to earth

- Always adds value and goes the extra mile on every design request – delivers an awesome brand experience

- Always finds creative solutions that stay true to the brand

- Actions design requests fast and gets things done quickly

- Always follows through on promises made and meets deadlines

- Seeks out opportunities to elevate the quality and impact of FastAid's visual brand

- Has a genuine passion for great design and visual storytelling

- Runs by systems and processes (file structure, brand guidelines) however remains flexible and creative

- Takes responsibility – acknowledges mistakes and fixes them fast

- Active listener with a desire to learn

- Takes the initiative and is proactive



We are looking for someone who can start full time quickly - ideally in the next 2-3 weeks.



Hours 7 or 8am to 4 or 5pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday.



Salary depends on level of experience and fit for the role.



For more information on the role, and to find out more about FastAid and our team, please submit a copy of your CV/resume and a video introduction of yourself to 
 look forward to hearing from you.

title: Email & SMS Marketing Specialist
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a part-time
 & SMS Marketing Specialist to help manage our weekly campaigns for a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We already have established Figma
 templates, so you won’t be designing campaigns from scratch. You’ll update the templates with new marketing messages, offers, products, and content, then build and send the campaigns through Klaviyo.



You’ll also be responsible for creating and sending corresponding SMS campaigns.



We plan to send approximately 2 campaigns per week.



A major part of the role will be analytics. We want someone who can go beyond Klaviyo’s reported revenue and attribution and analyze the actual performance of each campaign. Klaviyo can sometimes overattribute conversions, so we want to understand the real incremental impact of our
 and SMS campaigns and continuously improve performance.



Responsibilities:

- Update existing Figma
 templates with new copy, offers, products, and creative

- Build, QA, and schedule campaigns in Klaviyo

- Create and send SMS campaigns

- Manage approximately 2 campaigns per week

- Analyze campaign performance, including revenue, clicks, conversions, and attribution

- Look beyond Klaviyo's default attribution to understand true campaign performance

- Recommend improvements based on the data

- Help with segmentation and campaign testing when appropriate



Ideal Candidate



- Experience with Klaviyo

- Experience managing
 and SMS for e-commerce brands

- Comfortable working with Figma templates

- Strong understanding of
/SMS analytics and attribution

- Detail-oriented and able to work independently

- Strong written English and marketing sense



This is a part-time, hourly position.



When applying, please include examples of e-commerce
/SMS campaigns you’ve worked on and briefly explain how you evaluate the true performance of an
 campaign beyond Klaviyo-attributed revenue.







## How to Apply



Message us on OnlineJobs.ph with the subject:



"I WANT TO BE A VIDEO EDITOR"



Please include:



* Your portfolio and relevant e-commerce
/SMS campaign examples

* Your hourly rate in USD

* Your past 5 years of work experience, including the company, how long you worked there, and whether each role was full-time, part-time, or freelance



Applications without relevant
/SMS marketing examples will not be considered.

title: VA - Construction & Project Support
description:
We are a boutique residential building company based in NSW, Australia, specialising in custom homes, dual occupancies, major renovations and boutique developments.



As we continue to systemise and strengthen our backend operations, we’re looking for a reliable and detail-focused Virtual Assistant with construction industry experience to work closely with our Construction Manager.



This isn’t just a general admin role. We’re looking for someone who understands construction processes and can help keep our projects, costs, documentation and compliance organised and up to date.



The role would suit someone looking to become a long-term part of a small, driven team, with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as the business grows.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



The primary focus of the role will be supporting our Construction Manager with BOQs, quoting, project scheduling, job cost tracking and WHS compliance, together with general project administration.



TASKS

Assist with preparing BOQs, quotes and project schedules

Assist with take-offs and pricing from plans and project documentation

Maintain project information within Wunderbuild

Keep job costs, budgets and variations accurate and up to date

Assist with tracking supplier and subcontractor quotes

Maintain accurate project records and documentation

Assist with management of our HazardCo WHS system and contractor compliance

Assist with
 management and follow-ups

Prepare, organise and maintain documents and project files

General administrative support as required



REQUIREMENTS

Previous experience working with an Australian construction or building business is highly desirable

Experience with estimating, BOQs, take-offs, job costing or construction administration

Experience with Wunderbuild and/or HazardCo would be a significant advantage

Ability to read and interpret residential construction & engineering plans

Comfortable learning new construction software and systems

Confident using Dropbox and Google Workspace

Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy

Excellent written and spoken English

Able to work independently, follow through on tasks and meet deadlines

Reliable internet connection

Comfortable working directly with a busy Construction Manager



WORKING HOURS

Initially 10–20 hours per week, with the potential to increase

Flexible working hours, however some regular overlap with Australian Eastern business hours will be required

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position, rather than a short-term project



RATE

AUD $6–$10 per hour, depending on experience and capability. Please include your expected hourly rate in your application.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

- “Builder’s Backbone” at the very top of your application to confirm attention to detail

- A brief introduction about yourself

- Details of your experience working with construction or building companies

- Your experience with BOQs, take-offs, estimating, job costing and project administration

- Any experience with Wunderbuild, HazardCo, Dropbox and Google Workspace

- Examples of similar work you have completed

- Your expected hourly rate

- Your usual working hours and availability



We’re looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our team — someone who is organised, accurate, proactive and takes pride in keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes.



If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Finance & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Are you highly organized, detail-oriented, and confident working with numbers, systems, and day-to-day business operations?



We are looking for a dependable and proactive Finance & Operations Virtual Assistant who can support bookkeeping, financial administration, reconciliations, reporting, payroll-related tasks, documentation, and operational workflows.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating order, maintaining accurate records, improving processes, and taking ownership of recurring responsibilities.



You will provide ongoing finance, bookkeeping, administrative, and operational support, including:

• Maintain organized financial files, receipts, invoices, and supporting documents

• Assist with financial reporting and spreadsheet tracking

• Experience performing reconciliations

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

• Strong organizational and documentation skills

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities without constant supervision

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a US-based team

• Reliable, professional, responsive, and accountable

Strong Advantage: Candidates with experience in any of the following will stand out:

• QuickBooks Online

• Have you worked remotely with a US-based client, company, or team before? If yes, briefly describe your role and how you communicated with them.

• Have you used AI tools at work? If yes, share one example of how you used AI to organize information, save time, improve documentation, or create a better workflow.

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?

Role Overview



Candidates with a trades or construction admin background and hands-on experience with job management platforms (iTrade, Simpro or similar) will be prioritised for this role.



A family-run fire protection compliance business in Western Sydney needs a full-time Virtual Assistant to take over the repetitive compliance reporting and admin load, freeing the Operations Manager to focus on higher-value work. Compliance reporting alone currently consumes 15-20 hours of her week. The role starts with foundational data entry (test sheet preparation) and grows into defect reporting, invoicing, standard quoting, and client and tenant
 correspondence.



Success looks like a VA who reaches real autonomy within a few weeks, documents their own processes as they learn them, and can eventually own reporting and standard quoting end-to-end without needing constant check-ins.



What You'll Own



Test Sheet Preparation (Your Starting Point)



Prepare test sheets ahead of scheduled inspections by copying assets into the existing Google Sheets template (built-in formulas and pass/fail dropdowns)

Learn the compliance language and workflow of the business through this repeatable, detail-focused task



Compliance Reporting & Defect Documentation



Take raw inspection data recorded by field technicians on-site and compile it into formal defect reports

Clean up and format reports so they are ready for review and sign-off

Package finished reports using DocuSign before they go to clients

Learn the process live over several sessions, with full training provided



Invoicing & Quoting



Prepare invoices in iTrade once a job or report is signed off (flows through to Xero)

Once confident, prepare standard quotes from iTrade's preset pricing for common defects such as replacing extinguishers or smoke alarms

Non-standard or complex quotes stay with management



Client & Tenant Communication



Monitor and reply to ad hoc tenant booking enquiries by
 (roughly 2-3 per day)

Handle general correspondence with tenants, strata managers and clients

Review the last 2-3 months of inbox history early on to learn the business's language and common issues

Inbound phone calls may be introduced at a later stage



Document & Records Management



File incoming PDFs and council letters into the correct client folders

Keep the master compliance tracking spreadsheet up to date with due dates and report deadlines



Scheduling (Later-Stage Task)



Support routine scheduling of inspections across technicians and subcontractors

Keep scheduling data current in iTrade



Systems & Documentation



Work across iTrade, Xero, Simply Book, DocuSign and Google Workspace

Document each task as an SOP as you are trained on it, and review SOPs periodically



What We're Looking For



Experience



Prior experience in a compliance-driven, detail-heavy admin role

Trades, construction or field-services background strongly preferred, as it shortens onboarding

Fire protection experience is not required; full training on standards and defect terminology is provided



Communication Skills



Strong written English for tenant, strata manager and client correspondence

Confident, professional phone manner (phone work is not part of the initial scope, but may be introduced later)

Able to triage and respond to ad hoc enquiries calmly without needing everything spelled out



Technical Proficiency (Core Requirements)



Confident manipulating and cleaning structured data in Google Sheets or Excel, which is core to test sheets and defect reporting

Comfortable with invoicing workflows (iTrade and/or Xero)

Exposure to job or scheduling platforms (iTrade, Simpro or similar) is a plus

Comfortable working across multiple platforms (six currently), some of which may change as the business consolidates its systems



Organisational Skills



Able to bring structure and consistency to a high-volume, recurring task

Keeps track of where information lives across several systems without letting anything slip



Non-Negotiables



Detail-obsessed: catches inconsistencies in compliance data before they reach a client

Fast learner who can absorb "why this is a defect" explanations and apply them consistently

Proactively autonomous: does not wait to be told what's next and reaches independent ownership within weeks

Documents processes as they learn them

Discreet and trustworthy: confidentiality is essential, as you will handle sensitive compliance data tied to buildings and tenants

Comfortable with a structured communication rhythm: a morning WhatsApp message with the day's priorities and an end-of-day summary

Collegial team player, comfortable joining a close, family-run team

Comfortable with a workflow that may shift as the business reviews its tech stack



Working Arrangements



Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00am-4:00pm AEST (Philippines-based, 2 hours behind AEST)

Reports day-to-day to the Operations Manager, with the Director as a secondary reporting line



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of a function that sits at the centre of the business, with a clear path from data entry to reporting, invoicing and standard quoting

Full live training via screen-shared sessions, recorded so you can revisit them and don't need to keep asking

Work where accuracy matters: your reports protect buildings and the people in them

A structured, supportive communication rhythm rather than being left to guess

A friendly, close-knit family business where your input on systems and processes will be valued

title: Full-Stack Developer (AI-Fluent) — Build the Software That Runs Our Business
description:
TYPE: Full time, long term

SALARY: AUD $20 per hour (approx. AUD $3,450 per month at 40 hours/week)

HOURS: 40 hours per week

SCHEDULE: Overlap with 9am to 5pm Sydney time (roughly 7am to 3pm Manila time).

                     Some flexibility, but we need you online with the team most of the day.



ABOUT US

We're an Australian ecommerce group doing around $10M AUD a year across two brands: A Man & His Cave (pool tables, arcade machines, kegerators, man-cave gear) and Rumpus (made-to-order leather furniture).



We don't buy software. We build it. Our CRM, our operations tools, our reporting, our marketing systems are all things we're building ourselves, with AI in the loop. We're looking for one developer to take ownership of that.



This is a long term role. We're not looking for a project freelancer. We want someone who stays, learns the business, and owns this software for years.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB

Our founder builds fast. He'll have a working prototype by the end of the day, put together with AI, and it will do roughly the right thing.



What it won't be is finished. It won't handle the edge cases. It won't be structured so the next person can extend it. It won't survive real data and real users for six months.



That's your job. You take things from "it works" to software we can actually run a business on. You'll spend as much time finishing and hardening as you do building from scratch, and that's the point.



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD



1. Our CRM (the priority, already underway)

   We're replacing Salesforce with our own. Rep desks, lead routing, call and
 ingestion, ad attribution from Meta and Google, commission logic. Your first job is getting it finished and used daily by the sales team.



2. Connecting our marketing tools

   Klaviyo, Meta, Google Ads, our own campaign systems. Making them talk to each other and to the CRM.



3. Joining our data together

   Shopify, Salesforce, Aircall,
, ad accounts, inventory. They all hold a piece of the truth and none of them agree. We want one place where they do.



4. Operations tools

   Purchasing and reorder engines, stock cover, backorder allocation, shipping, install scheduling. What our ops team uses to d
 what to buy and ship.



5. Dashboards people actually use

   Sales performance, cash flow, commission, KPIs per team. Real reporting off Postgres, not spreadsheets.



6. Creative and AI systems

   Asset libraries, briefing pipelines, internal AI agents in Slack and on our websites, MCP servers, Claude API features.



7. Our two Shopify stores

   Theme and front-end work, landing pages, and replacing the paid Shopify apps we currently rent with our own.



REQUIRED SKILLS

- TypeScript / JavaScript, React, Next.js

- PostgreSQL and SQL you can write well

- Building and consuming REST and GraphQL APIs

- Strong front-end design sense. These tools get used all day. If one is ugly or slow, people go back to spreadsheets and your work was wasted.

- Confident with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar)

- Good written English. You'll work directly with the founder every day.



NICE TO HAVE

- Shopify: Liquid, Admin GraphQL API, Functions, webhooks

- Anthropic / Claude API, MCP servers, AI agent patterns

- Experience building internal business tools or dashboards



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Someone genuinely full stack, comfortable from database to pixel

- Someone who knows the difference between code that runs and software that is finished, and has the discipline to close that gap

- Someone we can hand a messy business problem to, not a written spec

- Someone who tells us when something will be late, before it's late



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

You work directly with the founder. No project managers, no tickets sitting in a queue for a week. You will watch the thing you built get used by real people the same week you built it.



We use AI heavily and we want you to. You're not competing with it. You're the person who architects it properly, reviews what it produces, ships it, and owns it when it breaks.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application (see below)

2. Short interview call

3. Paid trial task, so we both know it's a fit

4. Offer. Rate reviewed at three months.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. We read every one and we bin the copy and paste ones. Send us your answers for the following questions using this link: 



1. Two live links to things you've built, and exactly what you did on each.

   Working products, not just GitHub repos. Internal tools and dashboards count for more than marketing websites.

2. One thing you shipped using AI tools, and what it changed about how you work.

   Be specific.

3. In a few sentences: tell us about a time you inherited something half built.

   What did you have to fix before it was genuinely ready for real users?

4. Use the word SLATE on the last question under the BACKGROUND SECTION so we know you read this properly.



Everyone who answers all four properly will get a reply.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
About us



We're a plaintiff personal injury firm. We handle catastrophic injury, trucking and commercial vehicle crashes, wrongful death, premises liability and medical malpractice. We have a few hundred open files and we're still growing. A former district judge and a former prosecutor run the firm, so we care a lot about honesty in how we report time, deadlines and mistakes.



What the job is



You take the file once suit is filed and carry it through trial prep. You know where every case stands and what's due next. Day to day, that means:



Pleadings: petitions, amended petitions and service

Discovery: interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, discovery responses, and defendants' written discovery questionnaires

Records and damages: records requests, business records affidavits, Section 18.001 affidavits, and watching for counter-affidavits

Experts: lining up experts, collecting reports and filing designations

Depositions: notices, subpoenas and exhibits, plus coordination with opposing counsel, court reporters and clients

Deadlines: calendaring the docket control order and tracking every deadline on every file

Mediation and trial prep: mediation packets, exhibit and witness lists, and pretrial filings



You'll work every day with the attorney, the case manager and the legal assistant on your team. There's no training period.



What we're looking for

At least one year of plaintiff personal injury litigation on filed cases

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure

Daily use of case management software across a heavy caseload

The habit of telling the attorney bad news early



We don't hire people who pad their hours. This has to be your only job.



Working remote

A private workspace and internet reliable enough for depositions and client calls, with backup internet and backup power

Online during Central Time business hours, on camera for team meetings, and responsive on chat

Time logged by task as you go

Firm files stay in firm systems

Hours and pay



The job is 40 hours a week, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time. In Manila, that's 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. from mid-March to early November, and 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. the rest of the year.



The rate is $6.00 to $10.00 per hour in U.S. dollars, as an independent contractor, based on your tested experience. Discretionary bonuses are available. Include your full ask in your application: rate, PTO, holidays, allowances and payment method.



Screening questions



Answer each one in a few sentences, in your own words. We care more about how you think than about polished writing.



A docket control order arrives with a trial setting eight months out. What goes on the calendar first, and how do you work backward from trial?

A defendant was served 24 days ago and there's no answer on file. What do you check, and what do you tell the attorney?

The defense serves a counter-affidavit to your client's Section 18.001 affidavit. What do you do that day, and what does it change about the case?

Expert designations are due Friday. The expert hasn't sent a CV or report, and the last provider's records haven't come in. What do you do, and in what order?

It's Monday. You have discovery responses due today, a deposition tomorrow with exhibits that aren't final, an upset client on the phone, and an attorney who wants an amended petition by Wednesday. How do you order that list, and why?

title: Operations Manager – Luxury Vintage Bags Business
description:
IMPORTANT: Please start your application with the word “VUITTON”.



We are a Japan-based company specializing in luxury vintage products, particularly vintage Louis Vuitton.



We are currently developing a new business in the Philippines and are looking for a reliable and proactive Philippines Operations Manager who can help us build and manage the local operation.



Our planned business model is:



Japan sourcing → Philippines → Local repair → Live selling → Customer → Sales



The Japanese side will be responsible for sourcing and purchasing products in Japan.



Your role will be to build and manage the business operation in the Philippines.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Researching and finding reliable local luxury bag repair businesses

• Contacting repair businesses, requesting quotations, comparing prices and services, and negotiating when necessary

• Managing and tracking repair jobs, deadlines, costs, and quality

• Researching the Philippine market for vintage Louis Vuitton and other luxury products

• Researching actual local selling prices and customer demand

• Finding and contacting potential livestream sellers / live selling hosts

• Building relationships with reliable sellers and local business partners

• Coordinating live selling operations

• Managing inventory received from Japan

• Coordinating local delivery and customer communication

• Tracking sales, expenses, payments, and inventory

• Preparing regular reports for the Japan-based director

• Identifying problems and proposing practical solutions

• Taking responsibility for completing tasks independently



This is NOT simply a virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who can think like a business operator.



You will be expected to research information, contact real businesses, communicate with people, compare different options, negotiate when necessary, make recommendations, and take responsibility for results.



IMPORTANT PART OF THIS POSITION:



We are currently testing whether this business model can work successfully in the Philippines.



We do NOT want someone who simply agrees with our business idea.



If you believe that our business model has problems, risks, or is not profitable, we want you to tell us honestly.



Please give us your opinion about:



1. What do you think about this business model in the Philippines?

2. What do you think are the biggest opportunities?

3. What do you think are the biggest risks or problems?

4. What would you improve or change?

5. If you were responsible for the Philippine operation, what would you do first?

6. What would your plan be for the first 30 days?



We value honest opinions, practical thinking, research ability, communication skills, and problem-solving more than simply agreeing with us.



If you are hired, we plan to start with a small test of approximately 10 products.



You will gradually be given responsibility for different areas of the business, for example:



Week 1:

Research local repair businesses and contact potential repair partners.



Week 2:

Research and identify strong livestream sellers and contact potential candidates.



Week 3:

Research local market prices, customer demand, and competitors.



Week 4:

Help create a practical plan for selling the first 10 products.



The exact tasks may change depending on what we learn from the market.



We want to build this business together with someone who can identify problems, test ideas, and improve the business based on real results.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person.



TO APPLY:



Please start your application with:



“VUITTON”



Then briefly answer the following:



1. Where are you currently located in the Philippines?

2. What management, operations, or business experience do you have?

3. Have you worked with local businesses, suppliers, repair shops, or other partners?

4. Do you have experience with e-commerce, livestream selling, social media selling, or luxury products?

5. What do you think about our business model?

6. What would you improve or change?

7. What would you do during your first 30 days?

8. Why are you interested in this position?

9. What is your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation?



Please do not simply give a generic answer.



We are interested in your actual thoughts and how you would approach this business.

 Flow Buildout: Aid us A-Z in the process of re-creating (and differentiating) a flow email sequence identified from a competitor. You’ll work on the hands-on tasks such as making the final edits within Klaviyo, identifying which images, copy, etc we need to create to accomplish the task. 





What You’ll Need

 (REQUIRED) Confident in contributing to visual or creative work — using tools like Canva, CapCut, GPT, Photoshop, or other simple editors to rebuild mockups, brand elements, or quick creative tasks.



(REQUIRED) Experience working in any performance-based role — marketing, ecommerce, content, or any environment where your work needed to convert, generate leads, or drive outcome.

(Your work isn’t created with the intention to look pretty, rather to make one part of the business process convert better) 



(HIGHLY PREFERRED) Ability to use AI/ChatGPT to produce clean, usable outputs — whether it's copy, mockups, images, or refined research ideas or notes. You should know how to prompt well, refine outputs, and apply them to real use cases.



(HIGHLY PREFERRED) Comfortable building or organizing docs and trackers in Google Sheets, Docs, Drive — formatting should be clean, structured, and usable by someone else without explanation.



(HIGHLY PREFERRED) Email campaign/flow creation or assistance in development in assets relating to the email (the copy, images, formatting, editor like klaviyo)



(HIGHLY PREFERRED) Experience working in small team, ecommerce environment

Sabre Digital is a London based ecommerce growth agency. We build and scale Shopify stores for UK, US and AU DTC brands across fashion, jewellery, homeware and personalised products. Our work covers paid advertising, Shopify development, conversion rate optimisation and email retention.



We are hiring an experienced media buyer to take ownership of Meta and TikTok across our client accounts, working directly with the founder and with a creative developer who produces the assets you brief.



THE ROLE

You own the ad accounts. That means the media buying, the testing roadmap, the reporting, and crucially the creative direction that feeds it. We do not want someone who only adjusts budgets. We want someone who looks at yesterday's numbers, works out what the winning ad is actually saying, and briefs the next three variations to test.



You will work alongside a creative developer who produces statics, video edits and UGC cutdowns. Your job is to tell them exactly what to make and why, then read the results and iterate.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

MEDIA BUYING

- Plan, launch and manage Meta and TikTok campaigns across prospecting, retargeting and retention audiences

- Manage daily budgets and pacing across multiple client accounts, scaling winners and cutting losers quickly

- Structure accounts properly: campaign architecture, budget allocation, audience setup, exclusions, placements

- Manage full funnel activity from cold traffic through to retargeting and existing customer campaigns

- Monitor performance daily against ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, hook rate and hold rate, and act on what you see

- Maintain accurate tracking: pixels, CAPI, event setup, UTMs, catalogue and feed health



CREATIVE STRATEGY AND TESTING

- Run a continuous creative testing roadmap. Always have the next batch in flight

- Analyse ad level performance to identify which hooks, angles, formats and offers are actually working, then build the next round from those learnings

- Write clear creative briefs for the creative developer covering concept, hook, script, format, on screen text and reference examples

- Direct production of statics, video ads, UGC edits and motion assets, then review and approve before launch

- Write ad copy: primary text, headlines and hooks that match the creative and the offer

- Source and evaluate competitor and category creative for angles worth testing



REPORTING AND CLIENT WORK

- Produce weekly and monthly performance reporting with clear commentary on what happened and what changes next

- Flag budget, tracking or landing page issues early rather than after the month ends

- Feed insights back into the wider team, since what wins in ads should change the product pages too



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (ESSENTIAL)

- Proven hands on Meta Ads experience managing real ecommerce budgets. You must be able to tell us the accounts you ran, the spend level and the results

- TikTok Ads experience, or strong Meta experience plus genuine willingness to own TikTok from day one

- Ability to read ad level data and draw the right conclusion, not just report the numbers back

- Strong creative instinct. You should have opinions on why one hook beat another

- Experience briefing designers or editors and getting usable assets back

- Solid ad copywriting in natural, native quality English

- Comfortable with Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Shopify analytics and GA4

- Reliable high speed internet and a capable working setup

- Self managing. You check accounts daily without being told

- Available full time with hours overlapping UK business hours



DESIRABLE

- Agency experience running several client accounts at once

- Experience with attribution tools such as Triple Whale or Northbeam

- Experience with Google Ads or Klaviyo, since our channels work together

- Experience with catalogue, feed and Merchant Centre work

- Experience scaling an account past a meaningful monthly spend threshold and knowing what broke when you did



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

title: BD Manager - Crypto DeFi Partnerships (Uncapped Bonuses)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn, email, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Video Editor Content Support
description:
Video Editor — Rewired Kids & Live Loud



Location: Fully Remote (must have some overlap with Mountain Time / Colorado business hours) 

Job Type: Full-Time, Monthly Retainer — $700–$1,000/month depending on experience, with a paid trial period at a lower rate before moving to full retainer



 Reports To: Content Marketing Manager, with final sign-off from the Owner



About Us



Rewired Kids and Live Loud are family-focused brands with a real storefront and a growing online presence. We're a fast-paced office and online business, and we thrive on speed, accuracy, and details. We need an editor who can turn raw footage into content that actually stops the scroll, fast, and stays true to our brand every single time.



Trial Period



This role starts with a paid trial period at a lower monthly rate. Once you've shown you can turn around high-quality edits fast, stay on brand without heavy direction, and manage your own workflow, the retainer moves to the full rate.



Top Priorities

Short-form content. Reels, TikToks, and ad creative that are built to hook, hold attention, and convert.

Long-form to short-form. Taking longer videos and pulling out the moments worth clipping, cutting, and repurposing across platforms.

Thumbnails and static images. Clean, on-brand graphics that support the video content.

Speed without sacrificing quality. Using AI tools to move faster and stay consistent, not to replace your eye or your creativity.

What You'll Do

Edit short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and
, including Reels, ad creative, and organic posts

Take long-form video and cut it down into multiple short-form pieces that each stand on their own

Design thumbnails and simple supporting images that match our brand every time

Use AI tools, including Claude, to speed up captioning, scripting support, and staying on-brand without slowing down output

Use CapCut as your primary editing tool for fast-turnaround, social-native content

Keep every project organized in Notion so nothing gets lost, footage is easy to find, and anyone on the team can see where a project stands

Turn one filming session into a minimum of two weeks of usable content across platforms

Watch for what's actually working (hooks, pacing, formats) and bring ideas for what to try next, not just execute what's handed to you

Keep a sharp eye on brand consistency: fonts, colors, tone, and pacing should feel like us every time

Hit deadlines consistently. Content that's late doesn't help us

What We're Looking For

Available to start right away and commit full-time, this isn't a role we can wait around on

Available to overlap with Mountain Time (Colorado) business hours, even working fully remote

Non-negotiable, hands-on experience with Claude, Notion, and CapCut. This isn't a "willing to learn" role, you need to already be fluent in all three

A real portfolio of short-form content, especially Reels, TikToks, or ad creative that shows you understand pacing and hooks

Experience turning long-form footage into short-form clips that don't feel like leftovers

Speed, accuracy, and efficiency. We move fast and need someone who can keep up without cutting corners

Sharp attention to detail. Brand consistency, timing, captions, and quality all matter every time. If you've read this far, message us with the word GIRAFFE before you apply, we pay attention to who pays attention

A keen eye for what makes people watch, stop scrolling, and stay engaged. You should have real instincts for what's unique and entertaining, not just technically correct

Strong organizational habits. You should be able to manage multiple projects and versions without anything getting lost or mixed up

Comfortable using AI tools to move faster, not as a replacement for your own editing judgment

Nice to Have

After Effects or motion graphics experience

Basic sound design or audio cleanup skills

Experience editing for health, wellness, family, or parenting-focused brands

How to Apply



Message your portfolio or reel examples, especially anything short-form, ad-focused, or repurposed from long-form content. Show us edits you're proud of and tell us why they worked.

title: Social Media & Community Coordinator (Influencer & UGC)
description:

ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a multicultural doll brand built to help children and families feel seen, celebrated, and connected to their culture. We're looking for someone to become the connective tissue of our brand online — across social media, creators, ambassadors, and community.



We're not necessarily looking for the most experienced candidate — we're looking for the right one. If you have sharp social media instincts, a genuine eye for storytelling, and you learn fast, we want to hear from you even if your resume is shorter than you think it should be.  which creators to approach and why, edit and post our short-form content, manage the day-to-day of our ambassador relationships, and turn community love into brand assets we can actually use.

Social Media Management & Growth (20%)

 which creators are the right fit and why — mission, audience, and cultural alignment come before follower count

ClickUp, Google Drive, Instagram, TikTok,
, Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, Planoly

would be highly regarded.

title: Social Media Content Specialist
description:
Virtual Colleague, under Shoutout Digital Group, is looking for a Social Media Content Specialist to support one of our established Australian ecommerce clients.



We’re looking for someone who understands how good social content actually works, not just how to schedule a post or put together a basic Reel.



The main purpose of this role is to take the brand’s creative direction, photography, raw video footage and UGC and turn them into current, engaging social content that showcases the products well, captures attention and helps build interest in the brand.



You’ll work closely with the client’s Creative Lead and an existing Graphic Designer. The Creative Lead will guide the overall creative direction, while the Graphic Designer will handle more polished or design-heavy brand assets.



Your focus will be the social side of the content: d
 how an idea should come to life on Instagram, TikTok and other platforms, editing short-form content, adapting assets into the right formats, publishing them at the right time and helping manage the community once they’re live.



You should be able to look at a piece of raw footage or an existing asset and think about things like: What should the hook be? Is the pacing right? Is there too much text? Does the audio fit? Would this work better as a Reel, Story or carousel? And most importantly, will this make someone stop, watch and become interested in the product?



That social instinct is what matters most to us.



What you'll be doing



- Turn raw footage, photography, UGC and existing assets into Reels, TikToks, Stories and other social-first content

- Edit short-form videos with a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, cuts, captions, typography and audio

- Adapt and repurpose content for different social platforms and formats

- Work with the Creative Lead to make sure content direction translates well to social

- Collaborate with the Graphic Designer when more polished or design-heavy creative is needed

- Keep up with current trends, content styles, platform behaviour and what is performing well

- Manage the day-to-day content calendar and make sure approved content is scheduled and published correctly

- Publish directly within social platforms and check captions, tags, links and formatting before content goes live

- Respond to comments and DMs in the brand’s tone of voice during key engagement periods

- Escalate sensitive, negative or commercially important enquiries when needed

- Support occasional UGC or creator follow-ups where required



What we're looking for



- A strong portfolio of recent social-first work is essential

- Hands-on experience producing or editing Reels, TikToks, Stories and carousels

- A strong eye for hooks, pacing, typography, audio and overall content structure

- An understanding of how content should change depending on the platform and format

- Good judgement around what feels current, engaging and appropriate for an ecommerce brand

- An understanding of how social content can showcase products, build interest and support sales

- Experience managing a content calendar, scheduling and publishing social posts

- Confident written English and comfortable responding to comments and DMs

- Organised, reliable and comfortable working independently with direction from a remote team

- Someone who actively keeps up with social media rather than relying on what worked a few years ago



Again, you do not need to be a full graphic designer. There is already a dedicated Graphic Designer in place, and you’ll work closely with them when more polished or design-heavy assets are required.



We also don’t expect you to own the overall social media strategy. You’ll have direction from the Creative Lead. What we do need is someone with enough social judgement to know how that direction should be executed well on the platform.



We’re open to candidates from fashion, beauty, health, food, hospitality, lifestyle, ecommerce, interiors, homewares or any other visually led category.



The quality of your social work matters much more to us than the industry you’ve worked in or how many years you’ve been doing it. ;)



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote role supporting a client based in Queensland, Australia.



The general working schedule will be:



Monday - Friday

12:00 PM – 8:00 PM AEST (Queensland)

10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine Time



There is some flexibility around the schedule, but you'll need to be available during the client's evening social media window. The brand typically posts around 7:00 PM AEST (5:00 PM PHT), so being online around this time is important for engaging with the community, responding to comments and making sure published content is running smoothly.



Any flexibility around your exact working hours can be discussed during the interview.



Why join us?



At Virtual Colleague, we work with Australian businesses that value long-term relationships, trust and great people.



You'll have clear creative direction and support, while still having plenty of opportunity to use your own skills and social media knowledge. We're looking for someone who enjoys the creative side of social, takes pride in what they publish and wants to grow with a team long-term.



How to Apply



If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to see your work.



Please apply through our application form:







Please make sure your application includes a portfolio or links to your best social media work, particularly Reels, TikToks, carousels and short-form video edits. Your portfolio will be one of the main things we use when shortlisting.



The form should only take around 5 minutes to complete.



Please note that we will only review applications submitted through the application form. Applications or follow-up messages sent through OnlineJobs.ph will not be included in the shortlisting process.



If you're shortlisted, we'll invite you to one friendly interview. That's it. No multiple interview rounds or time-consuming unpaid tests. We like to keep the process simple and respectful of everyone's time ;)



We can't wait to learn more about you!

title: Business Development Representative – Consumer Brands & Retail
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to drive outbound sales efforts and generate qualified meetings for our leadership team. This role is responsible for identifying high-potential prospects, building targeted lead lists, executing personalized outreach campaigns, and nurturing relationships until opportunities are ready to engage.



Success in this role isn't about sending the highest volume of
s — it's about building genuine relationships, delivering thoughtful outreach, and consistently booking qualified meetings. The ideal candidate has experience selling agency or professional services, understands the nuances of outbound prospecting, and is comfortable testing new outreach strategies to continuously improve performance.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week), with opportunity to increase as the business grows

Time Zone: Must be available during PST business hours

Compensation: 7 USD per hour with 20 USD per qualified attended meeting



Key Responsibilities



1. Prospect Research & Lead Generation



Research and identify high-potential prospects across a variety of growth stages

Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, industry publications, databases, and market research

Monitor buying signals such as fundraising announcements, product launches, and retail expansions to identify new opportunities

Continuously refine lead lists to ensure a healthy and qualified sales pipeline



2. Outbound Sales & Relationship Building



Execute personalized outbound outreach via
, LinkedIn, and where relevant, cold calling

Craft thoughtful, relevant messaging tailored to each prospect rather than relying on generic templates

Manage follow-up sequences and nurture prospects over time

Test new messaging approaches and outreach strategies to improve campaign performance

Book qualified discovery meetings for the leadership team



3. CRM & Pipeline Management



Maintain accurate records within HubSpot, including contact information, outreach history, and pipeline stages

Track prospect engagement, follow-up activities, and meeting outcomes

Ensure all sales activities are documented and opportunities remain organized and up to date

Report on outreach performance, meetings booked, and pipeline activity



4. Continuous Improvement



Share learnings and recommendations to improve outbound strategy and campaign performance

Leverage AI tools and sales technology to improve efficiency, research, and outreach quality

Collaborate with leadership to refine messaging, targeting, and sales processes as the business grows



Required Skills & Experience

title: Creative Strategist – DTC & Meta Paid Social
description:
About the Role



This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made.



You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D
 what gets made, and why, is.



Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Central European Time

Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative Strategy



Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list

Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them

Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three

Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test

Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners



2. Brief Writing



Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats

Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes

Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant



3. Research



Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use

Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about

Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself

Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages

Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing

Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing



4. Performance Review & Recommendations



Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role

Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution?

Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call

Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs



5. AI Integration



Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job

Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it

Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good

Conceptual Clarity: You can explain the difference between a desire, an avatar, an angle, a concept, and a hook without hedging

Copywriting: Excellent written English and real copywriting ability — the hook is the job; you write UGC scripts yourself and brief editors and creators directly

Awareness Levels: You write for different levels of awareness and know why a hook that lands on someone already shopping falls flat on someone who hasn't named the problem yet

Iteration: You iterate deliberately — you know what to change in a winner and what to leave alone

Compliance: Comfortable inside a compliance-tight category; health and supplement claims live within real limits and you write inside them by instinct

Organization: Organized enough to carry two to three brands at once without dropping a deadline

Bonus: Agency experience, worked directly alongside Meta media buyers, experience with advertorials, VSLs, and long-form direct response

READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.

.

We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.
