description:
Hello ! We are an AI video production company scaling two founder LinkedIn accounts, and we are looking for an experienced salesperson to run those conversations full time.



The leads are already there. The replies land in the inbox every single day. What is missing is the person who answers them properly, qualifies them, and books the call.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION, AND IT IS NOT A VA ROLE. A SALES BACKGROUND IS REQUIRED. We are hiring a salesperson or a seasoned appointment setter, not a virtual assistant. No prospecting, no list building, no scraping. Conversations only, handled by a professional who already knows how to sell.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day, full time.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls enter the system over time, and after that, managing other setters. For the right person that is a real opportunity to grow inside the company, under a revised agreement.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 150 to 180 per day across both accounts

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Work the reactivation pool: warm leads who did not convert the first time

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. A real sales background. Non-negotiable.



Minimum 2 years in sales or appointment setting: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



We will not consider applications from general virtual assistants with no sales track record.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full-time dedication



This is a full-time role, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday, structured as a morning block, a one-hour break, and an afternoon block. From time to time, one to three hours of Saturday work may be requested when campaign activity requires it, agreed in advance. Your daily window is fixed and agreed at interview, and it stays fixed once agreed.



During working hours you are dedicated exclusively to us, with no other job or client at the same time.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Hungry. Someone who wants to book calls and earn from them, not someone who wants to complete tasks.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract, paid every two weeks by bank transfer in USD

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term, full-time role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market, with a clear path towards running qualification calls and then managing setters



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $1,150 USD per month, full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Plus a $6 USD bonus for every qualified call you book that goes through the first call and progresses to a closing call. This rewards quality, not just volume.

- Realistic total at full speed: $1,300 to $1,700 per month.

- Paid every two weeks by bank transfer in USD.



This is deliberately top-of-market pay for this role in the Philippines. We want to be the job you prioritize, and we want someone who stays and grows with us.



>> HOW TO APPLY IN WRITING



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video.

Both are required for the application to be complete.





1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
 .

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years in sales and in appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- How many conversations you were handling at the same time at your busiest

- Your internet setup and your power backup plan, in one or two lines

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone





>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.





>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai

title: 7+ Years B2B Sales Rep | Closer
description:
Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week Initially | $7/Hour + 7% Commission



Looking for a proven full-cycle B2B salesperson who can independently build pipeline, develop opportunities, close business, and secure payment.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL



You will sell the Workplace Burnout Review.



The Workplace Burnout Review is a $9,500, three-week advisory engagement that identifies the workplace conditions contributing to burnout and provides leadership with a tailored 90-day action plan.



Typical buyers include Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, executives, and other senior leaders responsible for teams, functions, transformation efforts, PMOs, or business units.



YOU WILL



• Build and manage your own B2B sales pipeline

• Conduct targeted outreach to senior business decision-makers

• Move opportunities through the full sales cycle independently

• Close business and secure client payment



LOOKING FOR



• 7+ years of direct B2B sales experience

• Proven responsibility for personally closing B2B business

• Experience independently building and managing your own pipeline

• Experience managing the full sales cycle from prospecting through close

• Evidence of individual closed revenue, quota attainment, or measurable sales results

• Experience selling higher-value B2B services, professional services, or solutions

• Experience selling to Directors, VPs, executives, or other senior business decision-makers

• Strong written and spoken English

• Ability to operate independently with minimal day-to-day supervision



Experience selling consulting, advisory services, HR solutions, leadership services, organizational development, transformation services, or similar B2B offerings is especially relevant.



This is not a lead-generation, appointment-setting, sales-support, or customer-service role. You must have personally closed B2B business.



COMPENSATION



In addition to $7/hour, you will earn 7% of collected client revenue on every sale you source and close.



SCHEDULE



10 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to increase based on demonstrated sales performance and pipeline development.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer all three questions and number your responses 1–3.



1. How many years have you personally been responsible for closing B2B sales? What did you sell, what was the typical deal value, and who were the buyers?



2. Describe one B2B sale you personally sourced and closed from initial outreach through buyer commitment or payment. State the approximate deal value and your role in the sale.



3. What measurable individual sales results can you provide, such as closed revenue, number of deals closed, quota attainment, or sales growth?



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.

title: Operations & Finance Specialist for Ad Agency (Xero Experience Required)
description:
Company: Kingfisher Ads, a US-based advertising agency specializing in Google and Meta ads for the golf industry



About us



We run paid advertising for golf brands. Small team, direct communication, no corporate fluff. We move fast and we want to automate everything worth automating.



Why this role is different



Most ops roles are about doing the tasks. This one is about owning them and making them better.



You'd own the processes that keep the agency running: client onboarding, reporting workflows, hiring admin, our new creator program, and the monthly finances. We care as much about how you improve these processes as how well you run them.



We use AI a lot (Claude especially) and we're building more automation into how we work (Zapier, n8n). You won't be expected to build complex automations alone, that's a team effort, but you should be the person spotting what's worth automating, helping set it up, and handling the exceptions once it's running. If you're the type who asks "why are we still doing this by hand?", you'll do well here.



If you've worked at an ad agency before, you already know the work we're talking about: client reporting, onboarding, campaign admin, the monthly rhythm of it all. If you've improved or automated processes around any of that, especially reporting, you're exactly who we're looking for.



What you'd own



Operations (most of your time)



- Improving our recurring processes and helping automate the ones worth automating, client reporting workflows are a big one

- Building and running client onboarding checklists in ClickUp

- Screening job applicants against our criteria before they reach us

- Documenting SOPs across the agency

- Tracking software subscriptions and flagging waste

- Contractor payment admin as our freelance team grows



Content creator program (new, you'd help build it)



We're building a roster of golf content creators for client campaigns. Creators apply through our website, and you'd help run the program from the ground up:



- Screening inbound creator applications and keeping the creator database current (rates, availability, content styles, past performance)

- Managing creator relationships day to day: coordinating briefs, deadlines, and deliverables across campaigns

- Tracking creator payments alongside the rest of contractor payment admin



Lead generation support



- Building and cleaning prospect lists of golf brands and businesses that fit our ideal client profile

- Keeping the CRM organized and up to date

- Researching prospects before sales calls



Finance (smaller in hours, non-negotiable in skill)



This is the part that has to be done right every month, and it's why Xero experience is a hard requirement:



- Monthly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero

- Client billing prep: pulling ad spend from Google and Meta, calculating fees, staging invoices

- Completing our monthly cash flow tracking spreadsheet and recommending improvements to how we categorize and track

- Moving clients onto automated payments (ACH)

- A short monthly financial summary: revenue by client, spending trends, anything we should look at



Being "familiar with Xero" isn't enough for this role. We need someone who has owned the month-end process themselves, reconciliations done, everything coded, reports checked, and who stands behind their own numbers.



Requirements



- 2+ years of bookkeeping experience with Xero, including owning the month-end process. This is a hard requirement

- Experience working with US-based businesses

- Strong written English

- Detail-obsessed. Reconciliations that are almost right are wrong

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

- Own computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available for a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time (most of the work is flexible)



Big bonuses



- Experience working at or with an advertising or marketing agency, especially on client reporting

- Direct experience managing or supporting ad campaigns (Google, Meta)

- Zapier or n8n experience

- ClickUp or similar PM tool experience

- Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) in your work

- Experience working with influencers or content creators



Pay



Includes 13th month pay. Full time, long-term role. Salary as listed, paid monthly.



Hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will do a short video interview followed by a paid test task. We respect your time and won't ask for free work.



How to apply



Start your application with the word KINGFISHER so we know you read this post.



Then answer these three questions. Applications without answers to all three will not be considered:



1. Describe a repetitive task you automated in a previous role. What tool did you use and what was the result?

2. What's a common mistake you see in how small businesses track cash flow?

3. Walk us through your month-end process in Xero, step by step. What do you check before you consider the month done?



Include the types of US businesses you've done bookkeeping for, and mention any agency or ad management experience.

title: TITLE: Video Translator – AI-Assisted Subtitle Localization for European E-commerce Ads
description:

title: Technical Research Assistant (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
We build AI-powered SaaS tools and automation systems. Before we build anything, we need to know what to build it on — which provider, which model, which machine, at what cost. That's this role.



🔧 What you'll do

• Answer specific questions with real numbers: what's the cheapest reliable way to do X at our volume?

• Compare providers and models on actual cost, speed, reliability and limits — not marketing claims

• Test things yourself: sign up, run it, measure it, report what you saw

• Work out cost per image, per video, per month — and spot the pricing traps

• Check licenses and terms, and flag anything risky before we commit

• Deliver a short brief: your recommendation first, then the comparison and your sources

• Keep re-checking — this stuff changes monthly



✅ What we're looking for

• You dig until you find the real answer, and you can tell hype from fact

• Comfortable enough with Linux and the command line to run a test yourself

• You can build a cost breakdown and defend every assumption in it

• You write short and lead with the recommendation

• You use AI tools heavily — but verify every number at the source. We check.



⭐ Nice to have

• You already follow the open-source AI model scene

• Experience renting or self-hosting GPUs

• Media, voice or transcription tooling experience



💼 What we offer

• Remote, [~4h overlap with GMT+5]

• Your research d
 what we build on, and you'll see it shipped in weeks



📩 How to apply

Send link with a short intro, your rate, and a one-page sample brief answering this:



What's the cheapest reliable way to generate 10,000 AI images a month, and what would it cost?



Drop your answers here in the google application form: 



Real prices, linked sources, assumptions stated. We read the brief first.

title: Real Estate Analyst
description:
About Us:

Mega Land Pros is a leading real estate investment firm that is focused on acquiring and managing real estate assets. Our highly experienced team specializes in identifying opportunities, closing transactions efficiently, and delivering exceptional results.



Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Real Estate Pricing Analyst. This role will be critical in acquiring and evaluating land deals, analyzing comparable properties, researching markets, and gathering data..



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.



Responsibilities:



- Research and evaluate vacant land properties as they come into our pipeline

- Search and analyze comparable land sales to determine market value

- Create accurate offer ranges and maximum allowable offer (MAO) to buy profitably

- Assess deal spreads, margins, and risk

- Review the property details such as size, topography, flood zones, access, utilities, etc.

- Set follow up tasks and notes in Salesforce for our Acquisitions Manager

- Market analysis and research

- Scrub and clean data

- Price properties using guidelines

- Format excel spreadsheets for direct mail campaigns

- Coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, and attorneys

- Create and follow SOPs and checklists

- Communicate clearly and effectively with the team

- Perform due diligence tasks such as ordering photography, land surveys, soil tests, calling utility companies and counties

- Miscellaneous real estate-based tasks



Qualifications:



- Experience with real estate, specifically vacant land and land pricing

- Strong analytical and research skills (Google Maps, Zillow, Redfin, LandID, County GIS, etc.)

- High attention to detail and accuracy in reporting

- Strong spoken English with minimal accent to communicate effectively with US-based clients

- High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Takes full ownership

- Follows checklists

- Meets deadlines

- Communicate clearly

- Ability to learn and work independently

- Proficient in Excel

- Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment



Soft Skills needed:



- Strong and fluent in speaking and writing English

- Detail orientated

- Kind and empathetic



Working Hours:



Must be available between 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern Time

No other jobs are to be worked during this time. Working another job will result in immediate dismissal.



Pay:



- Base Salary between $4/hr-$6/hr (depending on experience)

- Performance-based cash bonus

- On-time payments



How to Apply:



Record a 3-5 minute Loom video with an introduction of yourself, then answer the following questions:



1. What is your experience in real estate or land pricing?

2. How would you price per acre for a 5 acre property in a rural area?

3. What experience do you have with processing direct mail campaigns?

4. What tools have you used and how do you research land parcels?



Include the Loom video link in your application email.



Use the subject line: “Real Estate Analyst - Your Name”



Send your resume to 
 highlighting your experience with real estate (land), dispositions, and investors/buyers.



Important:



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Social Media & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant
description:
Neda Painting is a family-owned painting business based in Canberra, Australia. Established in 1977, we provide high-quality residential and commercial painting services to homeowners, builders, property managers, schools and organisations.



We are looking for a reliable, proactive and highly organised full-time Virtual Assistant to support our social media content, lead generation,
 outreach, website and administrative activities.



Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation &
 Outreach:

• Research qualified leads, including builders, property managers, real estate agencies, schools and other organisations.

• Use Apollo or similar tools to identify decision-makers and verified contact details.

• Create and maintain a clear, accurate and organised lead database.

• Write and manage professional
 outreach sequences in the business owner’s voice.

• Track contact dates, templates, responses, status and follow-ups, and provide regular performance reports.



Capability Statement Development:

• Assist in creating a capability statement that highlights the company’s services, experience, and unique value propositions.

• Collaborate with the team to ensure the capability statement aligns with company branding and messaging.



Website Management:

• Regularly update and manage website content using WordPress, ensuring information is current and aligned with company values.

• Collaborate with the team to create new content that highlights our services and expertise.

• Monitor website analytics and recommend improvements to enhance user engagement.



Social Media Management:

• Develop, curate, and manage social media content across platforms such as

title: Senior U.S. Bookkeeper – Multi-Entity Real Estate & Accounting Cleanup
description:
Victory Rock Capital is a Texas-based real estate investment and development company seeking an experienced Philippines-based Senior U.S. Bookkeeper.



Our immediate priority is reconstructing and organizing our 2025 accounting records and preparing accurate financial reports for our U.S. CPA. After the cleanup is completed, this can become an ongoing long-term bookkeeping position.



Current records include: business bank statements, credit-card statements, Patriot payroll records, owner contributions and reimbursements, company formation documents, invoices and receipts, and multiple company/project entities. We currently do not have QuickBooks or finalized financial statements.



Responsibilities include:



Reconstruct historical bookkeeping from bank and credit-card records

Categorize and reconcile transactions

Prepare Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets

Prepare General Ledger and Trial Balance

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and payroll

Track owner contributions, reimbursements, distributions and potential loans

Maintain accurate separation between multiple legal entities/SPVs

Identify intercompany transfers

Prevent investor/project capital from being incorrectly categorized as operating revenue

Maintain fixed-asset schedules

Identify missing, duplicate or questionable transactions

Prepare CPA-ready financial records

Flag uncertain transactions rather than guessing

Help establish QuickBooks Online and professional monthly bookkeeping procedures after cleanup



Required experience:



3+ years professional bookkeeping/accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based companies

Strong knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping

QuickBooks Online experience

Bank and credit-card reconciliation experience

Experience preparing P&L and Balance Sheet reports

Experience cleaning up incomplete or inaccurate books

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Excellent written and spoken English

High attention to detail and confidentiality



Strongly preferred:



U.S. real estate or investment-company accounting

Multiple LLC/entity bookkeeping

Intercompany accounting

Experience working with U.S. CPAs

QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification

Accounting/Accountancy degree

Philippine CPA qualification



Compensation: $10–$12 USD/hour depending on experience.



Schedule: Approximately 20 hours per week initially. Hours may decrease once the historical cleanup is completed.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Put the words “BALANCE SHEET” on the first line of your application.



Then answer:



How many years of professional bookkeeping experience do you have?

How many years have you worked with U.S.-based companies?

How many years of QuickBooks Online experience do you have?

Have you completed catch-up or cleanup bookkeeping projects?

Have you managed bookkeeping for multiple companies or entities?

Do you have real estate, investment-company, private-equity or fund-accounting experience?

What accounting degree or certifications do you have?

What is your requested hourly rate?

How many hours per week are you currently available?

When can you start?



Finally, answer this accounting question:



You see a $25,000 deposit into a company's bank account. You cannot determine whether it is revenue, investor capital, an owner contribution, a loan, or a transfer from another company account. What exactly would you do before recording the transaction?



Candidates who advance will complete short job-related accounting exercises. Finalists will complete a paid practical bookkeeping assignment using fictional financial records.

title: Social Media Reels Editor – Short-Form Content
description:
RAYIS Weddings is looking for a creative and talented Social Media Reels Editor to join our team!



We’re a wedding photography and filmmaking studio, and we’re looking for someone who can help us turn our beautiful wedding footage into engaging, creative, and scroll-stopping short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.



This role is perfect for someone who genuinely enjoys creating short-form content and understands that a great Reel is about more than just putting clips together, it’s about storytelling, emotion, pacing, music, and creativity.



What You’ll Do



- Edit short-form wedding Reels, TikToks, and Shorts

- Turn wedding footage into engaging and creative social content

- Select clips, music, pacing, transitions, and storytelling

- Create strong hooks that capture attention

- Add captions, text, and graphics when needed

- Keep up with current social media trends

- Bring your own creative ideas and editing style to our content



*We’re Looking for Someone Who Is VERY Creative*



Creativity is one of the most important things we're looking for in this role. We don't want someone who simply follows a template and puts clips together. We want someone who can look at a collection of footage and think: “How can I turn this into something people will actually want to watch?”



Someone with a strong creative eye, a great sense of storytelling, pacing, and music, and a good understanding of what makes social content engaging, while staying current with trends and bringing fresh ideas to the table.



Experience & Skills

- Previous experience editing short-form content

- Strong knowledge of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts

- Experience with video editing software such as Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar

- Strong understanding of pacing, music, transitions, colour, and storytelling

- Good attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

- Good communication skills



*Bonus Points

We’d love someone with experience in wedding, cinematic, luxury, or creative content, along with a strong understanding of social media trends, high-performing Reels, and ideally motion graphics or animation.



About RAYIS Weddings



At RAYIS Weddings, we create timeless, story-driven wedding films and photographs that capture each couple's day with authenticity and intention.



We care deeply about creativity, storytelling, and the little details that make each story unique. We're looking for someone who shares that mindset and wants to help us create social content that feels beautiful, authentic, emotional, and genuinely engaging.



How to Apply



Please send us:



- Your portfolio or examples of your best short-form edits

- Links to any Reels, TikToks, or Shorts you've edited

- A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience

- The editing software you use

- Your hourly rate or preferred project rate

- Your availability and typical turnaround time



Please make sure your portfolio includes short-form content. We’re especially interested in seeing how you approach storytelling, pacing, music, and creative editing.



We’d love to find someone who can become a long-term part of our creative team and bring fresh ideas to RAYIS.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About the Role

Trueline Talent is hiring an SEO Specialist to own and execute a high-growth organic search program. This is a real SEO role, not a coordinator who dabbles in search. You'll work inside Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Microsoft Clarity daily. You'll manage sitemaps and indexation across a site with thousands of programmatically generated pages. You'll build and manage local search presence in 40+ markets. And you'll optimize for how people actually search now: Google and AI answer engines both.



The goal is straightforward: drive qualified recruiting leads through organic search. Everything you do points at that number.



What You'll Do:

Sitemaps, Indexation, & Technical SEO. Own XML sitemap architecture on a large WordPress site: what gets included, what gets excluded, and how Google discovers and deindexes pages at scale. Monitor crawl coverage and indexation status in Search Console, diagnose why pages aren't indexing, and manage the technical side of large-scale content launches and removals. Flag and resolve crawl errors, canonical issues, and Core Web Vitals problems.



Google & AI Search Visibility. You understand that search no longer means ten blue links. Optimize for traditional Google rankings and for visibility in AI-driven search: Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and comparable answer engines. 



Structure content, schema, and entity signals so Trueline Talent shows up when employers ask an AI who to call, not just when they type a query into Google.



Multi-Market Local SEO. Stand up and maintain Google Business Profile listings across 40+ local markets, managing the full lifecycle of each profile: setup, verification, service-area configuration, and ongoing monitoring for accuracy, engagement, and suspension issues. You've done multi-location GBP work before and know how to keep listings compliant and live at scale.



SEO Strategy & Execution. Identify search opportunities through keyword research, Search Console data, and competitive analysis in Ahrefs. Translate findings into actionable content and on-page recommendations. Monitor performance, flag regressions, and continuously optimize underperforming pages.



Content Creation. Write and publish content that ranks and converts: city and sector pages, hiring guides, salary tools, ROI calculators, and other lead magnets built to capture earlier-stage search intent. You know the difference between content that performs and content that just exists.



Analytics & Reporting. Pull and interpret data across GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and Microsoft Clarity. Build clean weekly reports that connect SEO activity to lead flow. Know how to read a Clarity heatmap, diagnose a traffic drop, and explain what the data means in plain language.



PR & Backlink Outreach. Execute outreach to publications, directories, and link partners to build domain authority. Manage prospect lists, outreach sequences, and placement tracking, with a target of moving our Ahrefs DR toward 60+.



What We're Looking For

You are an SEO practitioner, not someone who has "done some SEO." You know these tools well enough to move fast without hand-holding, and you can explain what you're doing and why in terms that connect to business outcomes.



Required:

•	2 to 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in a content-heavy or local SEO environment

•	Working knowledge of XML sitemaps, indexation management, and crawl diagnostics on large sites

•	Demonstrated understanding of AI search (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) and how it changes content and schema strategy

•	Experience setting up and managing GBP listings across multiple locations, including verification

•	Proficiency in GA4, Google Search Console, and Ahrefs; you use these every week, not occasionally

•	Experience with Microsoft Clarity or similar behavior analytics tools

•	Demonstrated ability to write content that ranks; you can show us examples

•	Comfort working in WordPress and executing on-page changes directly

•	Strong organizational skills across multiple concurrent workstreams



Nice to have:

•	Experience in recruiting, staffing, or B2B services

•	PR or link outreach experience

•	Familiarity with SEOgets or comparable SEO tooling

•	Familiarity with HubSpot and how organic traffic connects to CRM lead flow



On AI Tools

We use Claude extensively to scope, plan, and produce work at scale: content drafts, CSV builds, reporting, strategy. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you do need to be open to learning it as a core part of the workflow. This is a real leverage point and we'll expect you to build fluency fast.



Compensation & Details

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST (U.S. Central Time) 



About the Role 



We're a growing marketing agency looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Digital Ads Specialist to monitor and manage paid advertising campaigns for a portfolio of client accounts. 



Because we're an agency, you won't be managing ads for just one business. You'll handle multiple clients on each platform. For example, you might run Google Ads for several clients and Meta Ads for several others, each with its own budget, goals and reporting needs. Many of our clients are in the same industry (landscaping and outdoor living), so accounts share a lot of structure, and you'll have established processes to work from. 



You won't be doing this alone. Our paid media strategist sets the strategy, budgets and optimization direction for every account, so your time goes to execution and monitoring rather than planning from scratch. We'll keep an open conversation about workload as your book of accounts grows, and we'll add team support when it's needed. 



Over time, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility, including training in new platforms like Microsoft/Bing, Pinterest, TikTok and LinkedIn. 



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and the opportunity to become a trusted member of our team - not someone looking for a short-term freelance project. 



About Us 



Here Molly Girl is a marketing firm focused on strategy, design, websites, digital advertising, and marketing services for a variety of clients. 



Our sister company, Script Marketing, specializes in marketing for landscaping and outdoor living companies across the U.S. 



We’re a small, collaborative team that values: 

•  Doing great work 

•  Clear communication 

•  Efficiency and structure 

•  Taking ownership of your responsibilities 

•  Attention to detail 

•  A positive, supportive work environment 



What You’ll Be Responsible For 



1. Daily Ad Monitoring 

•  Daily Ad Monitoring (replace the platform list) 



You'll monitor paid advertising campaigns across your assigned client accounts, starting with: 



•  Google Ads 

•  Meta Ads Manager 



As you grow in the role, you'll also monitor these (we'll train you): 



•  Microsoft/Bing Ads 

•  Pinterest Ads 

•  LinkedIn Ads 

•  TikTok Ads 



2. Campaign Management & Execution 



Within parameters established by our team and paid media partner, you’ll: 



•  Start, stop, and pause ads and campaigns 

•  Make basic budget and bid adjustments 

•  Take immediate protective action when necessary - for example, pausing a campaign experiencing an unexpected spend spike 

•  Document changes and communicate what happened and what action you took 

•  Pull basic campaign performance reports when requested 



You will not be responsible for determining overall cross-platform budget strategy, translating client goals into a media plan, or developing advertising creative concepts. 



3. Tracking & Communication 



You’ll help us stay organized across multiple client accounts by: 



•  Maintaining daily and weekly account tracking logs 

•  Updating assigned tasks and account information in 
 

•  Communicating with the team through Slack 

•  Immediately escalating significant issues 

•  Clearly explaining what happened, which account was affected, what you observed, and what action you took 



We don’t expect you to install or troubleshoot pixels, tags, or conversion tracking systems. However, you should understand advertising data well enough to recognize when tracking appears incorrect and flag the issue. 



Responsibilities You’ll Grow Into 



Once you understand our processes, accounts, and expectations, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities, including: 



•  Building campaigns in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager 

•  Setting up audiences, placements, budgets, and campaign settings based on provided strategies 

•  Uploading approved copy and creative 

•  Launching new campaigns 

•  Performing additional campaign optimizations within established guidelines 

•  Building and launching campaigns on additional advertising platforms 



Tools & Platforms You’ll Work With 



Experience with every platform is not required, but you should be comfortable learning new systems quickly. 



•  Required experience: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager 

•  With time, we'll train you on: Microsoft/Bing Ads, Pinterest Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads 

•  Team tools: 
, Slack, Google Workspace 





What We’re Looking For 



Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager is REQUIRED. 

We care more about what you actually know how to do than the number of years you’ve been doing it. 



You may be a great fit if you: 



•  Have hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, ideally for more than one client or business at a time 

•  Understand campaign budgets, pacing, delivery, frequency, and basic performance metrics 

•  Can recognize when something in an ad account doesn’t look right 

•  Have strong attention to detail 

•  Are proactive about identifying and flagging problems instead of waiting for someone to ask 

•  Can work independently while following established processes and guidelines 

•  Use good judgment when something requires immediate action 

•  Have strong written and spoken English 

•  Can communicate an issue clearly and specifically 

•  Are comfortable using Slack and 
 or can learn them quickly 

•  Have a reliable computer and high-speed internet connection 

•  Have a backup plan for internet or power outages 

•  Can consistently work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time 



Previous agency experience is STRONGLY preferred. 



Managing advertising for multiple clients with different budgets, goals, timelines, and reporting needs is very different from managing advertising for one company. If you have worked in an agency environment managing multiple accounts, please tell us about that experience in your application. 



Experience with Pinterest, Microsoft/Bing, LinkedIn or TikTok Ads is a bonus but not required. We'll teach you these platforms. 



What Success Looks Like in This Role 



You’ll be successful in this position when: 



•  Active campaigns are consistently monitored and running as expected 

•  Budgets stay on track 

•  Problems are caught quickly rather than discovered days later 

•  Potential creative fatigue is identified early 

•  Unexpected changes in performance or tracking are flagged promptly 

•  Appropriate action is taken when an account needs immediate attention 

•  Changes and issues are documented clearly 

•  The team can trust that someone is paying close attention to every active ad account 

•  Over time, you become capable of independently building and launching campaigns from strategies provided by the team 



Compensation & Details 



•  Full-time (40 hours/week), Monday–Friday 

•  Work hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time 

•  Long-term position 

•  Competitive pay based on experience 

•  Payment via Wise 

•  Weekly pay for the first 2 months, then biweekly/monthly 

•  Paid time off after a 3-month trial period 

•  Philippine holidays observed 

•  Flexible unpaid leave with notice 

•  Pay increase once you're trained on and managing additional ad platforms 



What We Offer 



•  A long-term, stable position with a U.S.-based marketing agency 

•  Clear expectations and defined responsibilities 

•  A supportive, collaborative team environment 

•  Established advertising strategies and processes to work within 

•  Opportunities to grow your paid media skills 

•  Opportunities to take on greater campaign responsibility as you demonstrate your abilities 

•  Paid training on additional advertising platforms 

•  Open, ongoing conversations about workload, with added team support as the account load grows 



How to Apply 



Please read these instructions carefully. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered. 



1. Use This Exact Subject Line - 

Digital Ads Specialist – I Read the Details

 

2. Record a Custom Video 

Please record a 2–3 minute video specifically for this application. 

Do not send us a general introduction video that you use for other job applications. 



In your video, please tell us: 

•  A little about yourself and your paid advertising experience 

•  Your hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager 

•  Whether you have managed ads for multiple clients at the same time 

•  One real example of a problem you discovered inside an ad account and what you did about it 

•  Why you are interested in a long-term position with our team 



We’re not looking for a professionally produced video. A simple Loom or similar recording is fine. We want to hear directly from you and learn how you communicate. 



3. Answer These Questions 

Please answer the following questions in your application: 



1. You check a client’s Google Ads account and notice that the campaign has spent significantly more than expected for that point in the month. What would you check, and what would you do next? 



2. A Meta campaign that normally generates conversions suddenly shows zero conversions for the past two days, but spend and traffic appear normal. What would you do? 



3. You notice that an ad’s frequency has increased significantly and performance is beginning to decline. What might be happening, and what would you recommend doing next? 



4. Tell us about your experience managing multiple advertising accounts at the same time. If you have not worked in an agency before, tell us how you would stay organized while monitoring multiple client accounts. 



5. A client's Google Search campaign for lead generation has a healthy conversion rate, but the client says the leads are poor quality and aren't turning into sales. What is one thing you would look at to diagnose the problem, and what would you recommend? 



Important: Please answer these questions in your own words without using ChatGPT or other AI tools. We are not looking for perfectly polished answers. We want to understand your actual experience, judgment, and how you communicate. 



Want to Stand Out? 



If you have hands-on paid advertising experience, you may also include a redacted screenshot from a Google Ads or Meta Ads account you have personally managed. 



Please remove or hide all client names, company names, account numbers, or other confidential information. 

This is optional, but it can help us better understand your experience. 



What Happens Next 



•  We’ll review applications, videos, and written responses. 

•  Selected candidates may receive a few follow-up questions. 

•  Top candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview.

title: Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead (AI-Native)
description:
Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead (AI-Native)



Remote | Full-Time | $25 USD/hour | 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST



I’m looking for a Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead to join me in building and scaling a modern software platform for property management companies.



This is a hands-on technical leadership role. I’m not looking for someone who simply manages developers or spends most of their time in meetings. I want a strong engineer who can think architecturally, write excellent code, solve difficult technical problems, and lead a development team while moving quickly.



We’re building software and AI-powered automations that handle complex property management workflows, so the work involves real-world integrations, automation, data synchronization, multi-tenant architecture, and plenty of interesting edge cases.



What You’ll Do

Architect & Build

Own the technical architecture for scalable, multi-tenant SaaS applications.

Design systems that support both standardized workflows and client-specific customization.

Make thoughtful architectural decisions without overengineering.

Build prototypes and turn ideas into production-ready solutions.

Build Complex Integrations

Design and maintain integrations with property management platforms such as Rent Manager, AppFolio, Yardi, and Buildium.

Work with APIs, webhooks, authentication systems, data synchronization, and third-party services.

Develop reliable strategies for handling inconsistent or incomplete external data.

Automation & AI

Design resilient web scraping and browser automation systems when native APIs aren't available.

Leverage modern AI development tools to dramatically accelerate development.

Use Claude, Claude Code, AI agents, and AI-powered IDEs as part of your everyday engineering workflow.

Know when to trust AI-generated code—and, more importantly, when to challenge, test, refactor, or reject it.

Stay Hands-On

Write production code.

Debug complex issues.

Review pull requests.

Identify and resolve technical bottlenecks.

Improve testing, monitoring, reliability, and production performance.

Be willing to jump into the codebase rather than simply delegate.

Lead & Mentor

Provide technical direction to other developers.

Establish and maintain strong engineering standards.

Review architecture and code for quality, security, and maintainability.

Help the team move quickly without sacrificing long-term stability.

Work Directly With Me



I’m looking for someone who can take ambitious product ideas and turn them into simple, practical technical solutions.



You should be comfortable pushing back when you believe there’s a better or simpler approach. I value engineers who can say, “There’s a much easier way to build this,” and then explain why.



What I’m Looking For



Strong technical experience with:



TypeScript / JavaScript

Node.js

React / Next.js

Python

PostgreSQL

Modern cloud infrastructure

Automated testing

Monitoring and observability

Production debugging



You should also have experience with:



Multi-tenant SaaS architecture

Third-party API integrations

Web scraping and browser automation

Authentication and authorization systems

Data synchronization and event-driven workflows

Designing systems for reliability and scale

You’re the Kind of Engineer I Want If…

You’re a senior-level engineer who still loves writing code.

You naturally think about edge cases, failure modes, permissions, security, and data integrity.

You’ve worked with systems involving sensitive business or financial information.

You can look at a complicated requirement and find the simplest architecture that solves it properly.

You’re comfortable working independently and making technical decisions.

You move quickly but don’t cut corners that will create bigger problems later.

You enjoy mentoring developers and raising the technical bar.

You already use AI extensively in your development workflow.

You understand that AI can make you dramatically faster—but engineering judgment is still essential.

AI-Native Engineering Is Important



I’m specifically looking for someone who has embraced the new generation of AI-assisted development.



You should be comfortable using tools like Claude and Claude Code to:



Explore unfamiliar codebases

Generate and refactor code

Build prototypes quickly

Debug issues

Automate repetitive engineering tasks

Work with AI agents



But this isn’t about blindly accepting AI-generated code. You need enough technical depth to audit AI output, identify security and architectural problems, test thoroughly, and maintain high engineering standards.



Work Schedule & Compensation



Position: Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead

Employment: Full-Time

Schedule: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday

Hours: 40 hours/week

Rate: $25 USD/hour (~$4,000/month)

Location: Remote

Preferred: Philippines, but open to qualified candidates internationally outside the U.S.



How to Apply



Please send:

1. Your resume/CV (PDF format)

2. Links to your GitHub, portfolio, or relevant projects, if available

title: Experienced Land Comping VA — Real Estate Research + SMS (11AM–3PM EST)
description:
We are a U.S. land investment company that buys and resells vacant land parcels. We are hiring an experienced Virtual Assistant to run property comping and support our SMS seller pipeline.



Prior land or real estate comping experience is required. This is not an entry-level or training role. You must already understand what a comparable sale is and why a bad comp kills a deal.



What you will do:

• Comp vacant land parcels using our ChatGPT comping plugin — we will give you access and our exact prompt process

• Verify plugin output against the subject parcel: acreage, access type, zoning, subdivision, sold date

• Flag comps that do not match on size band, access type, or subdivision context

• Calculate and record price per acre; enter all findings into our comp sheet in a consistent format

• Flag missing data instead of estimating it — we need gaps identified, not filled in

• Manage inbound seller replies in Smarter Contact: tag leads, respond using our approved scripts, route qualified sellers to the owner

• Keep lead status and notes current so no seller goes unanswered



Requirements:

• Prior experience comping real estate or land — you must be able to describe your past process

• Available Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM New York time (EST/EDT). Fixed schedule, not flexible. For Philippines-based applicants this is roughly 12:00 AM – 4:00 AM local time — confirm you can work this consistently.

• Strong written English — you will be messaging U.S. property sellers directly

• Comfortable with Google Sheets, ChatGPT, and web-based research

• Reliable internet and backup power/connection



Nice to have:

• Experience with Smarter Contact, Podio, GoHighLevel, or similar CRM

• Experience with land wholesaling specifically



This role is NOT for you if:

• You have never comped a property before

• You estimate numbers instead of verifying them

• You are managing several other clients at the same time



How to apply:

Start your application with the word PARCEL so we know you read this fully.

Then answer:



Describe your comping experience. What property types, what markets, what tools?

How do you decide whether a comp is usable or should be thrown out?

Confirm you can work 11AM–3PM New York time, Monday–Friday. What time is that for you locally?



Applications without the code word will not be reviewed. Long-term role with hour increases for strong performers. (100$ bonus per deal closed.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager — Premium Health & Longevity Brand (Full-Time, Dedicated Placement)



Position overview

We are seeking an experienced Social Media Manager to lead the organic growth and daily management of a premium health and longevity brand's social media ecosystem.



This brand is built around expert medical education, podcast content, and high-value concierge services. The Social Media Manager will turn long-form content and expert insights into an organized, consistent, and measurable social media presence.



This role requires strategic thinking, strong writing, careful attention to medical context, and disciplined execution. The successful candidate must understand how to grow an audience without weakening the credibility of a premium healthcare brand.



This is a dedicated, full-time placement. The selected candidate will work exclusively for this client — no other accounts or clients during engagement.



Compensation: $950



Primary objectives



Increase followers, podcast audiences, reach, and meaningful engagement.

Strengthen awareness and credibility for the brand.

Establish a consistent content and publishing system.

Help identify which subjects, formats, and platforms produce the strongest results.

Prepare the social media ecosystem for future podcast and content monetization.



Brand and platform scope

Primary responsibility across:



Instagram


LinkedIn

TikTok

YouTube



Secondary support may be required for:



The client's personal Instagram and
 presence

Selected content from an affiliated regenerative health brand



Instagram is expected to be a priority platform, but the Social Media Manager must assess performance across the full ecosystem.



Responsibilities



Strategy and planning



Develop an organic social media strategy aligned with the brand's audience, positioning, and growth goals.

Create weekly and monthly content plans based on podcast episodes, archived content, current health topics, research, and ideas provided by the client and his team.

Recommend an appropriate balance of short-form videos, educational graphics, carousels, original videos, promotional content, and authority-building posts.

Research platform trends and apply relevant formats without making the brand appear generic or trend-dependent.

Recommend platform-specific adjustments to improve reach, retention, and engagement.



Content coordination



Review source materials and content ideas with the Video Editor.

Prepare clear briefs identifying the audience, main message, intended platform, call to action, and publication goal.

Coordinate the production of approximately 20–25 short-form clips and 10–15 higher-production assets per week, subject to an agreed production capacity and approval process.

Ensure deliverables are correctly categorized and that duplicate or overlapping assets are clearly documented.

Maintain an organized content library containing source files, finished assets, captions, thumbnails, approvals, and publication links.



Copywriting and publishing



Write or refine captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, calls to action, and supporting post copy.

Adapt copy for the language, audience, and conventions of each platform.

Prepare a visual content calendar showing the asset, caption, platform, proposed date, and approval status.

Submit content to the client for approval before publication.

Schedule and publish approved content accurately and on time.

Check every published post for formatting, caption, tagging, thumbnail, audio, and playback issues.



Engagement management



Monitor comments and direct messages across the assigned platforms.

Provide timely, thoughtful, and human responses based on approved guidance.

Avoid giving personal medical advice or presenting as a healthcare professional.

Escalate clinical questions, complaints, adverse experiences, legal concerns, media inquiries, and potential patient matters.

Identify recurring audience questions that may become future content topics.

Community or
 group management is not part of the initial scope unless added later.



Analytics and improvement



Track performance across social media and podcast channels.

Prepare a concise weekly report covering follower growth, reach, impressions, engagement, views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, direct messages, profile activity, and link clicks.

Identify the strongest and weakest posts and explain the likely reasons for their performance.

Recommend practical tests for the following week, such as different hooks, lengths, topics, thumbnails, captions, or posting times.

Maintain a monthly performance dashboard showing trends against agreed baselines and targets.

Focus on meaningful, sustainable growth rather than inflated or low-quality follower counts.



Brand, medical, and regulatory safeguards



Maintain a premium, consistent, and trustworthy brand presentation.

Preserve the meaning and context of all medical statements.

Never independently create, modify, or approve a medical claim.

Flag content that may require medical, legal, or regulatory review.

Apply heightened review to content involving stem cells, regenerative procedures, outcomes, or treatment benefits.

Protect confidential, patient, and unpublished business information.



Required qualifications



Proven experience managing social media for a premium, expert-led, healthcare, wellness, finance, legal, or other trust-sensitive brand.

Demonstrated experience growing audiences organically across multiple platforms.

Strong copywriting, editing, and content-planning skills.

Working knowledge of Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.

Ability to interpret analytics and turn performance data into practical recommendations.

Experience managing content calendars, approvals, asset libraries, and publishing tools.

Excellent written English and sound professional judgment.

Ability to work independently while communicating clearly with a client and creative team.

Careful attention to context, accuracy, confidentiality, and deadlines.



Preferred qualifications



Experience supporting a physician, medical practice, podcast, or health education brand.

Familiarity with healthcare advertising and medical-content restrictions.

Basic graphic design or short-form video editing skills.

Experience with podcast promotion, YouTube optimization, or newsletter/Substack growth.

Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, LinkedIn analytics, TikTok analytics, Canva, Google Workspace, and social scheduling platforms.



Initial performance indicators



Consistent and accurate publication of approved content

Week-over-week and month-over-month follower growth

Growth in podcast views, listens, or subscribers

Video watch time and audience retention

Engagement rate, shares, saves, and meaningful comments

Response time for assigned comments and direct messages

Timeliness and usefulness of weekly reports

Quality of recommendations based on performance data

Compliance with the approval and escalation process



Working arrangement



Full-time engagement, approximately 40 hours per week

Dedicated, single-client role — no concurrent clients

Remote position

Work schedule must include an agreed overlap with the client's Arizona business hours

All content requires client approval before publication

Works closely with a dedicated Video Editor

title: AI Video Designer (AI Video Generation) – Premium Spiritual Wellness Brand
description:
At Anima we sell spiritual tools that create a spark: crystal sets, incense and candles that open your eyes to what is already inside you. The products are a catalyst; the person is the creator. We sell on Amazon in the US, UK, Germany and Canada, our own store is launching, and we are a fast-growing e-commerce company that runs on AI. Image and video quality are the heart of the brand.



If you are interested in spirituality, meditation and crystals, and you care about this kind of product, you will fit here better than someone who only sees a clip to make.



THE JOB



You turn briefs into finished, believable videos with AI. Our Lead Creative Strategist gives you the product, the angle, the message, example copy and reference photos of the real product. You d
 the shots, the light, the setting and the pace, generate them with AI, keep the product exactly the product we ship in every single frame, add music, voice and captions, and deliver masters and cuts ready to publish.



The brief is detailed but it does not tell you shot by shot what to do. That is your craft: you know what beautiful looks like, what the best light and the best angle are, what setting the product belongs in. Today most of the work is Amazon listing videos and ad creatives. Website, social and new product lines come next. You do not d
 what gets made or write the brief. You own how it looks and how it moves.



Anima runs on AI systems. Our brand rules, product facts and procedures live in a company AI you are connected to from day one, and our AI agents help you get the wording and direction of each video right before you generate. The system gives you the what; you bring the how.



You are measured on three numbers we share with you every month: on-time delivery (you set the date, you hit it, target 95%), first-pass approval (approved with one round of notes or none, target 65% within six months), and output (finished masters and cuts delivered).



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Experience making AI videos that sell. The one thing we care about most. You have produced AI video for e-commerce or retail brands, for products that were actually sold: ads, listing videos, social. Not AI clips because they look beautiful. You can show three pieces and explain exactly how you made each one, shot by shot.

- Product fidelity in every frame. We make videos that do not look like AI videos. The product must be exactly the product we ship, and it must stay the same from the first shot to the last. Any person in the frame must look real. If the product changes between two shots, nothing else matters.

description:
# Full-Time Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator



**Get Me Insurance Inc. – Remote / Philippines**

Get Me Insurance Inc., a growing Canadian insurance brokerage, is looking for a **creative, skilled and highly reliable Full-Time Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator** for a long-term position.



Our **primary requirement is strong video editing and creative content production**. We need someone who can consistently produce professional Reels, short-form videos, graphics, posters, carousels and other engaging social-media content.



Digital-marketing responsibilities will also form part of the position, but **video editing and creative production are the primary focus.**



## Primary Responsibilities



- Edit professional Instagram Reels, TikToks,
 videos and YouTube Shorts

- Edit longer-form videos when required

- Transform raw footage into polished, engaging and professional videos

- Select the strongest portions of footage and structure them effectively

- Add captions, transitions, B-roll, graphics, music, sound effects and other creative elements

- Create professional **graphics, posters and promotional creatives**

- Design engaging **social-media carousels**

- Create thumbnails and other visual marketing materials

- Repurpose existing content into multiple formats

- Create reusable creative templates

- Produce educational, promotional and brand-building content

- Maintain consistent company branding

- Organize video, image and creative files

- Complete revisions promptly based on feedback



## Social Media Content



- Create content for Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube

- Assist with scheduling and publishing approved content

- Research trending video styles, hooks, topics and creative ideas

- Assist with captions, CTAs and hashtags

- Adapt content for different platforms

- Help maintain the content calendar

- Proactively suggest new creative and content ideas



## Editing & Design Software



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Adobe After Effects

- DaVinci Resolve

- Final Cut Pro

- CapCut Pro

- Canva Pro

- Photoshop or equivalent professional software



We care primarily about the **quality of your work, creativity, efficiency and final output**, rather than which specific editing software you use.



## Full-Time Working Hours & Accountability



This is a **full-time position requiring 8 working hours per day on a fixed schedule.**



**There are no flexible working hours.**



You must be available, responsive and actively working throughout your agreed working schedule.



**All working hours will be tracked through Hubstaff.**



Completing one video, graphic or assignment does **not** mean your working day is finished. Once an assignment is completed, you are expected to proceed with the next assigned task.



During working hours, you may be assigned different duties reasonably related to **video production, graphic design, social media, content creation and digital marketing.**



Reliability, punctuality, consistent attendance, communication, productivity and meeting deadlines are essential.



## Technical Requirements



You must have:



- A reliable computer capable of professional video editing

- Stable high-speed internet

- Backup internet connection

- A reliable contingency plan for computer/equipment problems

- Ability to use Hubstaff throughout your working hours



## Digital Marketing – Secondary Responsibility



When assigned, you will also assist with:



- Digital-marketing activities

- Online lead-generation support

- Competitor and market research

- Content and marketing research

- Social-media marketing

- Monitoring content performance and engagement

- Assisting with marketing campaigns

- Basic SEO and website-content support

- Identifying opportunities to improve reach, engagement and inquiries

- Other reasonable digital-marketing tasks assigned by management



Previous digital-marketing experience is preferred, but our **first priority is excellent video editing, graphics and creative-content production.**



## Skills Assessment



**Shortlisted candidates will be provided with raw/rough video footage and asked to edit it into finished content as part of our skills assessment.**



This assessment will help us evaluate your:



- Editing quality

- Creativity

- Ability to select and structure footage

- Captions and visual presentation

- Use of B-roll, transitions and other creative elements

- Understanding of short-form social-media content

- Ability to follow instructions

- Attention to detail

- Turnaround and communication



The assessment is intended to show us **how you approach actual raw footage**, rather than relying only on previously completed portfolio work.



## Compensation



**Starting Salary: ₱25,000 PHP/month**



Performance may be reviewed based on reliability, attendance, quality of work, creativity, productivity, meeting deadlines and contribution to the company's content and marketing objectives.



## Important



Please do not apply if:



- You cannot consistently work a fixed 8-hour daily schedule

- You are looking for flexible working hours

- Other jobs or clients will interfere with your availability

- You are uncomfortable using Hubstaff

- You regularly experience computer or internet problems without a backup solution

- You cannot consistently meet deadlines



We are looking for someone interested in a **stable, long-term position** who can become a dependable member of our team.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your video-editing portfolio

2. Your **best 3 Reels/TikToks/YouTube Shorts** that you personally edited

3. Examples of **graphics, posters and carousels** you personally created

4. Details of your social-media content experience

5. Any digital-marketing experience

6. Software you are proficient in

7. Your computer specifications

8. Your primary and backup internet setup

9. Your current employment/client commitments

11. Confirmation that you can work a **fixed 8-hour daily schedule and use Hubstaff throughout your working hours**

12. Confirmation that you are willing to complete the **video-editing skills assessment using raw footage provided by us**



Start your application with **“GMI CREATIVE”** so we know you have read the complete job posting.
