title: Graphic Designer with management skills
description:
Please read the whole post in order to be considered. 

We're looking for a multi-tasking person with real artistic skills. Yes, we are aware that in the age of AI some forms of "art" are "simple", but we're supplying a lot of artists worldwide with our products and can not have AI work in our designs. 



Please start your application/title with "I can draw!". If it's not there, your application will be ignored. 



The role is a mix of hands-on artistic creation and everyday graphic design.



Artistic/illustration work — original artwork for products like our annual T-shirt designs (we release at least 2 new designs per year). This is real illustration work, not just layout.

Graphic design — product infographics, web banners, and social media graphics across our sites.

Multi-brand work — we operate several businesses, so you'll be designing across different brand identities, not just one catalogue.

We also need occasional video editing (mostly short reels), so any video editing experience is a plus; please mention it in your cover letter. 



AI tools are welcome as part of your workflow (we use them across the company), but we're not looking for AI-generated artwork — we need someone who can actually draw and create.



What matters most: speed and reliability, time management and prioritising. 



We need someone who can:



Turn around a quick banner in 15 minutes when something's urgent

Also sit with a more involved project (like a t-shirt design) for a few days when it calls for depth

Know the difference between the two, and switch gears without drama.

Meet deadlines and manage projects. Ideally, manage projects and other designers working with us. 



We run multiple businesses, attend trade shows, and run frequent promotions — there's always something in the pipeline, and we need someone who treats deadlines as real.



Please note that AI-suggested rates by this website start with $3/hour. We're looking for a highly talented and experienced person for higher pay. If we don't find one, we might need to train the closest candidate, but that can come with a lower entry rate.

title: Virtual Medical Admin & Insurance Verification Specialist
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Virtual Medical Administrative Assistant with insurance-related tasks, patient communications, fax management, and medical-record organization.



The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in an electronic medical record system, and experienced with U.S. healthcare administrative workflows. This position requires accuracy, consistent follow-through, and the ability to protect patient information.



 Primary Responsibilities

 Prior Authorizations

•  Submit prior-authorization requests through payer portals, by fax, or through other approved methods.

•  Confirm that required clinical documentation accompanies each request.

•  Track pending authorizations and follow up with insurance companies.

•  Document authorization numbers, effective dates, expiration dates, approved services, and status updates.

•  Notify the appropriate team member when additional documentation, peer review, or clinical action is required.

•  Maintain an organized authorization tracker and escalate urgent or delayed requests.



 Insurance Eligibility and Benefits Verification

•  Verify insurance coverage before scheduled appointments.

•  Confirm active coverage for the applicable date of service.

•  Notify the appropriate office team member of coverage problems, missing information, or significant patient financial responsibility.



 Patient Text Messages

•  Respond to patient text messages using approved scripts and practice guidelines.

•  Assist with appointment confirmations, scheduling questions, office information, document requests, and other administrative needs.

•  Route clinical questions, medication requests, urgent concerns, and other matters requiring licensed staff to the appropriate team member.

•  Document patient communications in the designated system.

•  Maintain a professional, clear, and patient-friendly tone.



 Fax Management

•  Monitor incoming and outgoing fax queues throughout the workday.

•  Review incoming faxes and identify the patient, provider, document type, and required action.

•  Route referrals, authorization requests, medical records, test results, prescription-related documents, and administrative correspondence to the correct person.

•  Send outgoing faxes and confirm successful transmission.

•  Follow up on failed, incomplete, or missing fax transmissions.

•  Maintain an organized fax queue without leaving documents unaddressed.



 Document Scanning and Chart Organization

•  Scan or upload documents into the electronic medical record.

•  Match each document to the correct patient chart.

•  Select the appropriate document type, description, service date, and provider.

•  Sort documents into the correct section of the chart.

•  Review documents for missing pages, poor image quality, incorrect patient information, and duplicate records.

•  Route documents requiring review, signature, or follow-up to the appropriate team member.

•  Protect chart integrity by avoiding incorrect filing, duplicate uploads, and incomplete document indexing.



 Required Qualifications

•  Experience working in a U.S. healthcare practice, medical billing office, or healthcare support environment.

•  Experience with insurance eligibility verification and prior authorizations.

•  Familiarity with payer portals and electronic medical record systems.

•  Experience handling patient communications, medical faxes, and medical records.

•  Strong attention to detail and data-entry accuracy.

•  Clear written and verbal English communication skills.

•  Ability to follow written procedures and meet established turnaround times.

•  Ability to manage multiple work queues and prioritize urgent requests.

•  Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

•  Reliable computer, internet connection, and private workspace.

Most of what you'd make is long-form editorial reports plus supporting assets.



👋 A bit about me + who you'd be working with:



I'm Olivia Wheeler, founder of Acton Circle. My path was graphic designer, then product designer, then creative entrepreneur... so I've sat in your chair. I know the difference between a vague brief that makes you guess and real direction that lets you do your best work, and I aim to give you the second kind every time. I think about design the way a UX designer would: through how people really read, process, and d
.



I'm clear, organized, and direct (but always kind). I care that the work means something (we design for nonprofits expanding access to education, healthcare, housing, and opportunity), and I'd rather build a real, ongoing relationship than churn through freelancers. Do great work, be reliable, and we'll achieve awesome things together.



✏️ What you'd actually be doing:



Execute beautifully from established art direction

Designing long-form editorial pieces (mostly reports)

Adapting long-form pieces into other related assets

Prepping final files for print and digital (error-free and on-brand)

Applying edits cleanly and quickly

Keeping your own task updates current so nothing slips



✅ You're a good fit if:



You're reliable. Thursday means Thursday.

You don't need hand-holding. You ask questions up front, then you go.

You can execute a wireframe without wanting to redesign it.

You've got a real editorial eye for things like typeface, grids, white space, and flow.

You care about the work, not just the paycheck.

Coordinate priorities and daily activities across three businesses

Manage
s, correspondence, documents, and reports

title: Head Of Design
description:
Lead Graphic Designer (DTC / Ecommerce)



APPLY HERE: 



Pay: $15/hour + performance bonuses (monthly earnings can be doubled with bonuses).



We’re looking for an experienced, all-round design lead who we can trust with almost any design problem, from product imagery and packaging to advertising creatives and reviewing the work of other designers.



This is a senior, hands-on role for someone with strong commercial taste who can take ownership rather than simply wait for design tickets and instructions.



What You’ll Own



You’ll be responsible for creating and improving visual work across our ecommerce brands, including:



Product imagery for PDPs, packshots, and lifestyle creatives

Packaging design

Occasional Meta and static advertising creatives

AI-generated product and lifestyle imagery

Text-in-image creatives with strong typography and composition

Reviewing work from other designers and providing clear, actionable feedback

Maintaining and raising the overall visual quality of the brand

You’ll both design and lead. We want someone who can spot when something isn't good enough, explain why, and help turn it into something better.



Who We’re Looking For



You should have:



Strong experience in ecommerce or commercial product design

A portfolio demonstrating product-focused work, not primarily logos or branding projects

Excellent visual judgment, composition, typography, and attention to detail

Strong AI image-generation and editing skills

Experience creating convincing AI product/lifestyle imagery

Strong text-in-image skills

The ability to independently solve design problems

Experience reviewing other designers' work and giving useful feedback

A proactive approach. You should be comfortable suggesting improvements instead of waiting to be told exactly what to do.

Nice to Have



Agency or design studio experience

DTC ecommerce experience

Experience with jewelry, gifts, pet products, or other physical consumer products

Strong Figma skills

Advanced image compositing and retouching workflows

Experience designing high-converting ecommerce product pages or ad creatives

What This Role Is Not



This is not a basic graphic designer position and we're not looking for someone who primarily creates logos.



We need someone capable of owning commercial design work from concept through final execution and helping other designers improve their output.



Compensation



$15/hour + performance bonuses.



Strong performance is rewarded significantly, and monthly earnings can be doubled with bonuses.



We care more about the quality and commercial relevance of your work than the number of years you've been designing.



Work Location: Remote

title: Video Editor - Virtual Assistant
description:

I’m currently looking for a **skilled videographer/editor** to join my creative team.



This position has the potential to **transition into a full-time position** for the right person. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term. After an initial **60-day period**, there will be an opportunity for a **pay increase based on performance, consistency, and overall fit for the role.**



I’m specifically looking for someone who is **advanced in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve**. I don’t want someone who is only comfortable editing in CapCut — I want someone who genuinely understands **professional video editing, pacing, storytelling, transitions, sound design, effects, color, and overall visual composition.**



🚨 **PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:**



• You MUST have a strong creative eye

• You should be comfortable using professional editing software

• I’m NOT looking for someone who simply adds captions to videos

• I don’t want to see basic edits that rely heavily on captions

• I want someone who can take footage and actually **create something visually engaging**

title: SaaS Outbound Sales & Activation Rep
description:
Invoyce is an early-stage AI startup building an AI-powered back-office admin agent for small service businesses. Business owners can talk or type to Invoyce to handle work like estimates, invoices, payments, customer management, and other administrative tasks.



We're looking for an experienced outbound sales rep to introduce Invoyce to U.S. trade and service businesses, primarily landscaping, hardscaping, commercial cleaning, and tree care companies.



This is not a traditional SDR role focused on booking meetings. You'll cold call business owners, introduce Invoyce, identify interest, and help move interested prospects toward becoming active users. That might mean helping someone sign up during the call, texting or
ing them a signup link, or following up with interested prospects who haven't signed up yet.



We provide targeted prospect lists, a power dialer, training, and the tools needed to succeed.



We're looking for excellent spoken English, proven cold-calling/outbound sales experience with U.S. businesses, confidence speaking directly with business owners, and strong objection-handling skills. Experience calling landscaping, commercial cleaning, contractors, trades, or similar service businesses is strongly preferred.



When applying, please include a 60+ second voice or video recording introducing yourself and giving us a quick example of how you would open a cold call with a U.S. small-business owner. Applications without a recording will not be considered.



The role will begin with a 30-day paid trial at approximately 20 hours per week, with hourly compensation plus performance bonuses tied to customer activation. Strong performance can lead to significantly more hours and a long-term role with Invoyce.

title: Full-Time Video Editor & Social Media Manager — Fitness Brand
description:
Firstline Performance is a growing fitness coaching business looking for a creative, reliable video editor and social media manager to take ownership of our content production and publishing.



I’m an fitness coach. I will film content weekly and provide long-form talking videos, training footage, lifestyle clips, and plenty of B-roll. Your job is to turn that footage into professional, engaging content and consistently publish it across our social platforms.



We want someone looking for a long-term role who can work independently, meet deadlines, and grow with the business.



Daily Content Expectations Seven Days per Week:



One polished reel featuring strong storytelling, clean editing, captions, and relevant B-roll.

Three talking-head clips pulled from my long-form recordings, each with a strong hook and clear takeaway.

One polished carousel with useful fitness, nutrition, mindset, or coaching content.

Additional Instagram trial-reel variations created from the four daily videos, using alternate hooks, opening clips, pacing, or audio where appropriate.



These are five core content pieces per day, repurposed across Instagram, TikTok,
, and LinkedIn. You should adapt the format, captions, and messaging for each platform.



Responsibilities:



Review weekly footage and identify the strongest moments to repurpose.

Edit videos with accurate captions, clean audio, engaging pacing, and consistent branding.

Design professional carousels that look intentional and match our brand.

Write captions, calls to action, and on-screen hooks in my voice.

Manage the content calendar and schedule posts through Metricool or platform-native tools.

Ensure content publishes correctly and looks right on each platform.

Organize footage, finished edits, and content assets.

Monitor content performance and provide a short weekly report with recommendations.

Maintain a content backlog so publishing stays consistent throughout the week.



Seven-day publishing is required. Work can be batched and scheduled in advance within the agreed weekly hours.



Requirements:



Proven short-form video editing and social media management experience.

Access to your own editing software, suitable computer, and reliable internet.

Proficiency with tools such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut, plus Canva or an equivalent design tool.

Strong written English and attention to detail.

Ability to turn long-form recordings into engaging standalone clips.

Experience publishing across Instagram, TikTok,
, and LinkedIn.

Ability to manage a high-volume workflow without constant supervision.

Familiarity with fitness content and personal brands is a plus.



How to Apply:



Please include:



A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

Your portfolio, including talking-head edits, polished reels, and carousels.

The editing and scheduling tools you use.

Your availability and time zone.

How you would organize your workflow to meet this content schedule.

Confirmation that the starting rate and workload fit your availability.



Start your application with “FIRSTLINE” so I know you read the full listing.

title: Customer Support & Operations Assistant – Part-Time Remote
description:
We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Customer Support & Operations Assistant to help support our health supplement and digital-product businesses.



This is currently a part-time role of approximately 10 hours per week, usually spread across Monday–Friday. The workload may vary from day to day, but we expect around 1–2 hours of work per day on average. Our preference is to grow the right person with us, with the opportunity to increase hours and eventually transition into a full-time role as customer volume and operational responsibilities increase.



Customer support will be your main responsibility. However, because our current support volume is relatively manageable, you will also help with other recurring operational and administrative tasks when needed.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities may include:



- Replying to customer support
s and helping with orders, shipping, tracking, refunds, replacements, and general enquiries according to our SOPs

- Checking fulfillment and shipping issues and following up when necessary

- Monitoring inventory and keeping stock trackers updated

- Handling routine affiliate enquiries, sending promotional materials to affiliates

- Maintaining spreadsheets, trackers, and internal records

- Helping with occasional administrative tasks such as travel bookings, research, buy gifts for vendors

- Scheduling and publishing social-media content

- Scheduling approved weekly
s to our subscribers

- Helping document recurring processes and keep SOPs organized



You will not be doing all of these tasks every day.



Customer support and urgent operational issues will always come first. 



When support volume is lighter, the remaining time will be used for other business-support tasks.



Who We’re Looking For



You should be:



- Strong in written English

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and responsive

- Comfortable following SOPs

- Proactive and willing to learn

- Good with spreadsheets and online tools

- Comfortable communicating with customers, affiliates, and vendors

- Able to recognize when something can be handled independently and when it should be escalated

- Comfortable working in a small, fast-moving online business



Experience with customer support, Google Workspace, inventory management, affiliate marketing,
 platforms, or social-media scheduling is a plus.



You do not need experience in every area listed above.



Schedule



Approximately 10 hours per week



Usually around 2 hours per day, Monday–Friday, with some flexibility depending on workload.



Because customer support is part of the role, you should be available to check and respond to customer messages consistently throughout the workweek rather than completing all weekly hours in one or two large blocks.



Compensation



Starting rate: USD $5–$7/hour, depending on experience and capability.



There is significant room for growth in both hours and compensation as the role expands, with the potential to eventually transition into a full-time position.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the team, not just someone looking for a short-term side gig.



What Success Looks Like



After you have been trained, we want you to become someone who can confidently say:



“Customer
s are handled, shipping issues are followed up, inventory is updated, affiliate requests are organized, and nothing important has been forgotten.”



We do not want to constantly remind you about every task.



Over time, we want you to understand your recurring responsibilities well enough to help keep the business organized with minimal supervision.



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction about yourself

Your relevant customer support, e-commerce, or virtual-assistant experience

The tools and platforms you have worked with

Your current availability



Please also answer these three short scenarios:



1. Customer Support



A customer writes:



“I’ve been waiting almost two weeks for my order and the tracking hasn’t updated. This is ridiculous. I want my money back.”



How would you respond?



2. Inventory



You notice that we only have 120 bottles remaining and we are currently selling around 20 bottles per day.



What would you do?



3. Affiliate Support



An affiliate asks you to increase their commission from 75% to 80%, but you cannot find any internal approval for the increase.



What would you do?



At the beginning of your application, write:



“I read the entire job post.”



Applications without this line may not be considered.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

title: Cold Caller
description:
We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Sales Representative to join our growing company.



This is not a basic appointment-setting role where you simply read a script and move on. We are looking for someone with real sales experience who is comfortable having conversations with business owners, handling objections, building interest, and confidently moving prospects to the next step.



You will be making outbound calls to business owners and introducing them to our services. Your ability to think on your feet and have a natural conversation is extremely important.



What You'll Be Doing



-Making outbound cold calls to business owners

-Starting conversations and building interest in our services

-Qualifying potential clients

-Handling objections confidently and professionally

-Following a proven sales script while being able to adapt naturally to the conversation

-Booking qualified appointments or helping move interested prospects through the sales process

-Updating call outcomes and notes



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:

-Has previous cold calling and/or sales experience

-Has a proven ability to sell, not just read from a script

-Is confident handling objections such as "I'm not interested," "We already have something," "Send me some information," or It's too expensive"

-Can think quickly and keep a conversation going naturally

-Speaks extremely fluent English with clear pronunciation, natural conversational delivery, and strong grammar

-Can communicate comfortably and professionally with business owners in the United States

-Has a clear, professional phone presence that is easy for U.S.-based prospects to understand

-Is energetic, confident, and not afraid of rejection

-Is reliable and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

-Has a good internet connection, quality microphone/headset, and a quiet workspace

-Important Application Requirement



To be considered, please include a voice recording with your application.

In the recording, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following:

-Tell us about your previous cold calling or sales experience.

-Give an example of a difficult objection you have handled and how you responded.

-Pretend I am a business owner and give me a short example of how you would start a cold call.



We are paying close attention to your English fluency, clarity, communication skills, confidence, sales ability, and how naturally you handle a conversation.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



If you are an experienced salesperson who knows how to build rapport, overcome objections, and confidently sell over the phone, we would love to hear from you.

title: GoHighLevel Assistant & Automation Specialist
description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for a hands-on GoHighLevel (GHL) Assistant to support a business education and business credit company with its CRM, funnels, and automations.



Our team is actively building and improving the systems, and you’ll play an important role in helping complete the setup, test workflows from start to finish, keep everything organized, and maintain the systems as campaigns and programs go live.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, solving automation issues, and making sure everything runs smoothly.



What you’ll do:

• Build and maintain GHL workflows for lead capture, appointment booking, webinar/challenge registration, reminders, follow-up, and customer onboarding.

• Set up and maintain forms, surveys, calendars, tags, custom fields, pipelines, contact segments, and
/SMS campaigns.

• Update funnel and landing pages, checkout flows, thank-you pages, and membership/course access when needed.

title: Client Relationship Manager | No Graveyard Shift - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.

RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility

BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

description:
Senior Salesforce Administrator | Work From Home | Full Time



We’re OpenCorp. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped everyday Australians build wealth through property with the right strategy, advice and ongoing support.



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Technology Team. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can do more than administer Salesforce — you’ll work with stakeholders to understand business problems, design smart solutions and take them all the way from discovery through to delivery.



You’ll play a key role in how Salesforce supports our business, balancing day-to-day platform administration with solution design, project delivery, continuous improvement and mentoring other Salesforce Administrators.



What you’ll be doing:

- Leading discovery sessions and translating business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions

- Designing and building scalable solutions using Salesforce Flow, validation rules, formulas, approvals, custom objects and other declarative tools

- Managing Salesforce projects from discovery and solution design through build, testing, UAT, deployment and post-release support

- Reviewing Salesforce solutions developed by other team members to ensure quality, maintainability and consistency

- Helping strengthen our Salesforce DevOps and release-management practices

- Supporting integrations, APIs, data migrations and other connected business platforms

- Creating clear solution, technical, process and user documentation

- Mentoring Salesforce Administrators and sharing knowledge across the Technology Team

- Continuously identifying ways Salesforce can reduce manual work, improve data quality and create a better user experience



We’re looking for someone with

- At least 4 years of demonstrated Salesforce experience, including senior administration or consulting responsibilities

- Salesforce Certified Administrator certification

- Salesforce Platform App Builder certification or equivalent demonstrated capability

- Advanced hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation

- Proven experience taking Salesforce projects from discovery and requirements through build, UAT and deployment

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and confidently leading solution discussions

- Practical experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, structured deployments or release-management tools

- Experience conducting peer reviews and applying Salesforce development standards

- Experience supporting integrations, data migrations or connected business systems

- Strong problem-solving skills with the confidence to challenge a request and understand the real business problem before building a solution

- Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Highly regarded

- Experience mentoring Salesforce Administrators or helping improve technical standards across a team

- Experience working remotely with Australian, UK or US stakeholders

About you

- You’re an experienced Salesforce professional who likes understanding why something needs to change before d
 how to build it.

- You’re comfortable getting hands-on in Salesforce, but you can also step back and think about the bigger picture — the business process, user experience, data, integrations and long-term impact of a solution.

You care about building solutions that are scalable, maintainable and genuinely useful, and you enjoy helping other team members strengthen their Salesforce capability along the way.

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type of Work: Full-time | Hours: 40/week | Shift: Fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri

Compensation: $1,200–$2,000/month base + placement-linked bonus

Company: Talent Staffing and Recruiting — a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health, expanding into new verticals



JOB OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



REQUIRED



4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There will be a detailed walkthrough in the interview.

Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there's a live spoken check.

Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



Do NOT apply if:



Your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill).

You've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork.

You cannot name specific placements you personally closed.

Your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals, or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: You run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

Name ONE placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. (Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)

Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

A US client gives you a hard-to-fill job: CT Technologist in Colorado, 9 candidates already submitted by others, none hired. In 4–6 sentences: your fill strategy, step by step.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a 30–60 sec voice intro (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Cold Caller
description:
We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Sales Representative to join our growing company.



This is not a basic appointment-setting role where you simply read a script and move on. We are looking for someone with real sales experience who is comfortable having conversations with business owners, handling objections, building interest, and confidently moving prospects to the next step.



You will be making outbound calls to business owners and introducing them to our services. Your ability to think on your feet and have a natural conversation is extremely important.



What You'll Be Doing



-Making outbound cold calls to business owners

-Starting conversations and building interest in our services

-Qualifying potential clients

-Handling objections confidently and professionally

-Following a proven sales script while being able to adapt naturally to the conversation

-Booking qualified appointments or helping move interested prospects through the sales process

-Updating call outcomes and notes



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:

-Has previous cold calling and/or sales experience

-Has a proven ability to sell, not just read from a script

-Is confident handling objections such as "I'm not interested," "We already have something," "Send me some information," or It's too expensive"

-Can think quickly and keep a conversation going naturally

-Speaks extremely fluent English with clear pronunciation, natural conversational delivery, and strong grammar

-Can communicate comfortably and professionally with business owners in the United States

-Has a clear, professional phone presence that is easy for U.S.-based prospects to understand

-Is energetic, confident, and not afraid of rejection

-Is reliable and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

-Has a good internet connection, quality microphone/headset, and a quiet workspace

-Important Application Requirement



To be considered, please include a voice recording with your application.

In the recording, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following:

-Tell us about your previous cold calling or sales experience.

We are paying close attention to your English fluency, clarity, communication skills, confidence, sales ability, and how naturally you handle a conversation.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



If you are an experienced salesperson who knows how to build rapport, overcome objections, and confidently sell over the phone, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior E-commerce Customer Experience Specialist | Shopify | Full-Time
description:
Senior E-commerce Customer Experience Specialist | Shopify | Full-Time



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines

US$9–$12/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability



About Us



Inka Arthouse is a fast-growing international wall art brand operating across Australia, the United States, United Kingdom, New Zealand and Europe.



We're looking for an exceptionally capable Customer Experience Specialist to join our team full-time and long-term.



This is not an entry-level VA or basic scripted customer service position.



We're looking for someone who understands instructions quickly, retains what they've learned, uses strong judgment and can solve problems independently.



You won't be expected to know everything on day one. What matters is that when you're taught something, you understand the reasoning behind it, remember it and can apply that knowledge correctly to future situations.



What You'll Do



You'll handle customer enquiries including:



Order and delivery enquiries

Tracking and courier issues

Damaged orders

Replacements and refunds

Incorrect orders

Address changes

Product questions

Complaints and escalations

Shopify order management

Communicating with our warehouse and operations teams



Our goal isn't simply to answer tickets quickly.



We want customers to receive fast, thoughtful and genuinely helpful solutions, while making sensible decisions for the business.



What We're Looking For



Essential:



2+ years of e-commerce customer service experience

Excellent written English

Excellent comprehension and attention to detail

Strong ability to retain new information and processes

Strong problem-solving skills and independent judgment

Experience using Shopify

Experience handling refunds, replacements, shipping issues and unhappy customers

Ability to understand the reasoning behind a process rather than simply following a script

Ability to recognise when information is missing and ask the right questions

Comfortable learning new systems and processes quickly

Reliable internet and a professional home working environment



Experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, ShipStation or similar platforms is highly regarded.



Experience supporting Australian, US or UK e-commerce customers is also highly regarded.



AI Experience



We use modern tools and technology throughout our business, so you should be comfortable working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms.



We're looking for someone who can use AI intelligently to improve speed and quality, while still thinking independently.



You should be able to:



Use AI to assist with drafting and improving customer responses

Check facts and customer context before relying on an AI-generated response

Recognise when an AI response is incorrect, incomplete or doesn't make sense

Adjust responses to suit the actual customer and situation

Never blindly copy and send an AI-generated response



AI can help you work faster, but it should never replace your own understanding and judgment.



The Type of Person We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is sharp, reliable, curious and takes ownership.



If you're given a new instruction, you should be able to understand it, retain it and apply it again later.



If you encounter a situation you haven't seen before, we want you to think about what you already know and work out the most sensible solution.



If something doesn't make sense, we want you to recognise that and ask the right question rather than guess.



You should be comfortable making decisions within the processes you've been taught rather than needing every possible situation explained individually.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted member of the team and handle customer situations independently without needing constant supervision.



Compensation



US$9–$12 per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



We're willing to pay at the top of the range for someone who demonstrates exceptional comprehension, judgment, communication and e-commerce experience.



This is a full-time, long-term position.



How to Apply



Please answer all six questions below in your own words.



1. Previous experience



Which e-commerce companies have you previously worked for?



Please tell us:



What the company sold

Your position

How long you worked there

Your main responsibilities

2. Systems



Which platforms have you personally used?



Please explain your experience with Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Tidio or any similar systems.



3. Ticket volume



Approximately how many customer enquiries or tickets did you personally handle per day in your most recent customer service position?



4. Problem solving



Tell us about a difficult customer situation where there wasn't an obvious solution.



What happened, what did you d
 to do, and why did you make that decision?



5. Customer scenario



A customer ordered three framed prints.



Their order arrives and one frame has been damaged during delivery. The artwork inside the damaged frame is completely fine. The other two framed prints are also perfect.



The customer contacts you and asks you to send them three completely new framed prints.



What would you do, and why?



There isn't a specific script we're looking for. We're interested in how you think through the situation.



6. AI



Tell us how you've used Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool in a previous customer service or e-commerce role.



If AI drafts a customer response for you, what do you personally check before sending it?



Important Application Instructions



Please write your application answers yourself.



Do not use ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool to generate your application answers. We're specifically interested in seeing your natural written communication and how you personally think through problems.



Start your application with the words:



BLUE FRAME



Applications that don't follow this instruction may not be considered.



What Happens Next



We're taking this hire seriously and won't be selecting someone based purely on their CV or interview.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment involving realistic e-commerce customer service situations.



The assessment will look at:



Comprehension

Problem solving

Attention to detail

Written communication

Ability to retain new information

Independent judgment

Ability to apply previously provided information to new situations



Successful candidates will then have a short interview before we make our final decision.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of Inka Arthouse, take ownership of their work and grow with the business.

title: Finance & Business Development Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised, commercially minded and financially capable Business Development and Finance Officer to join our growing property and investment business.



This is a broad, hands-on position combining finance, accounting support, business development, property administration and general business operations.



The successful candidate will work closely with management and will be involved in the day-to-day financial running of the business, while also helping identify and progress new business, property and investment opportunities.



We are looking for someone who is proactive and capable of taking ownership of their responsibilities rather than waiting to be given instructions for every task.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing day-to-day financial administration and maintaining accurate financial records

* Recording and monitoring income, expenditure, invoices and payments

* Maintaining financial spreadsheets and internal management records

* Assisting with bookkeeping and preparing information for accountants

* Monitoring cash flow, upcoming payments and financial commitments

* Assisting management with budgets, financial information and reports

* Supporting mortgage, bridging finance, refinancing and other funding applications

* Preparing and organising documents required by lenders and finance providers

* Liaising with mortgage brokers, lenders, banks, accountants and financial professionals

* Liaising with solicitors, estate agents, valuers and other property professionals

* Following up outstanding finance, legal and property matters

* Maintaining organised records for properties, companies, finance facilities and transactions

* Monitoring important dates, renewals, payments and deadlines

* Researching potential property acquisitions and investment opportunities

* Carrying out initial financial assessments of potential opportunities

* Assisting with the progression of property purchases, refinancing and other transactions

* Researching potential lenders, finance products and business opportunities

* Supporting the development of new business projects and income streams

* Communicating with external companies and professional advisers on behalf of the business

* Preparing reports, documents, spreadsheets and information for management

* Helping improve internal systems and administrative processes

* Supporting general business operations where required



The role will develop as the company grows, so the successful candidate should be comfortable working across different areas of the business.



Qualifications & Experience



We would ideally like candidates to have one or more of the following:



* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics or a related subject

* AAT qualification or currently studying towards AAT

* Part-qualified ACCA, CIMA or similar professional qualification

* Previous experience within finance, accounting, banking, mortgages or financial administration

* Previous experience within property, real estate, mortgages or investment would be advantageous



You do not need to be a fully qualified accountant.



We are particularly interested in candidates who have a good financial understanding and are interested in developing broader commercial and business experience.



Skills Required



The successful candidate should have:



* Strong numerical ability

* Good understanding of basic accounting and financial principles

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills

* Good general IT and computer skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organisational and time-management skills

* Good written and verbal communication

* Ability to communicate professionally with banks, brokers, accountants, solicitors and other external professionals

* Ability to manage several tasks and deadlines at the same time

* Ability to work independently and use initiative

* Strong research and problem-solving skills

* Commercial awareness

* A professional and confidential approach when dealing with financial information



Personal Qualities



We are looking for someone who is:



* Proactive and self-motivated

* Reliable and organised

* Ambitious and willing to learn

* Commercially minded

* Confident taking responsibility

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

* Able to identify problems and suggest solutions

* Interested in property, finance, investment and business growth

* Looking for a position where they can develop and take on greater responsibility over time



Why Work With Us?



This is not a narrow finance or administration position.



You will have the opportunity to work directly with decision-makers and gain practical experience across finance, property investment, acquisitions, refinancing and business development.



As the business continues to grow, there will be opportunities for the successful candidate to expand their responsibilities and become increasingly involved in the financial and commercial side of the company.



This position would particularly suit someone who wants real responsibility, broad business exposure and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

My business and life are growing very quickly, and I need an exceptional operations manager / executive assistant—someone in the top 5–10%—to help me take things to the next level.

I'd love for us to become friends, not just employer-employee. I've experienced this with my previous assistants and it's been really fulfilling.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You'll be acting on my behalf—calling banks, vendors, and service providers, making real-time decisions, and managing personal and business logistics independently.



This is a dynamic, fast-paced and constantly evolving role. Things move quickly without step-by-step instructions, and you'll need exceptional judgment and discretion.



If you love taking initiative, solving problems creatively, and owning projects end-to-end, this could be the perfect role for you.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Keep in communication with vendors, service providers—handle situations independently

- Keep track of different dates & deadlines and follow through until completion

- Managing and maintaining multiple projects, tasks and systems

- Conduct in-depth research and troubleshoot issues

- Manage bookkeeping for business and personal finances





WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE



- Highly independent and proactive, able to act and d
 on my behalf across personal and business matters

- Exceptional decision-making and sound judgment in a variety of contexts and situations

- Clear, concise, and direct communicator – able to give clear feedback on what is working, what is not, suggestions & improvements

- Adaptable and resourceful, able to navigate new tools, platforms, and situations quickly

- Exceptionally organized and able to prioritize very effectively when many things feel time-sensitive

- Able to own and execute projects from beginning to end

HOURS

PAY & BENEFITS



- $1,400–$1,700/month, pay increases as you grow

- Severance pay

- 30 days off per year (flexible)





MY COMMITMENT TO YOU

I treat my teammates with respect and love. We're constantly learning and evolving together. I'm interested in you as a human being, beyond just our work—and I'll compensate you fairly and generously for outstanding work.





DON'T APPLY IF:

title: AutoCAD Draftsperson & Virtual Assistant (O&M Manuals)
description:
Direct hire only – no agencies, please.



About Us

We are a small, established company with over 21 years in the construction services industry, servicing a niche market. As leaders in our field, we’re known for delivering high-quality documentation to commercial contractors across Australia. We operate as a close-knit team and prioritise quality, long-term working relationships — reflected in our low staff turnover. We’re committed to investing in the development and retention of our people.



The Role

We’re seeking an experienced AutoCAD Draftsperson with strong attention to detail to help update Electrical, Hydraulic and Mechanical drawings. Our tasks are typically small in scope (1 to 6 hours each) with quick turnaround, most have a 2 day deadline. When you complete the work is up to you, as long as it’s delivered on time.



Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential. On-the-job training will be provided to get you up to speed with our standards and expectations in the construction industry.



Immediate Start

This role is available for an immediate start.



Workload & Rate

• Workload: Approx. 4–8 hours per week, with potential to grow

• Rate: PHP 650 per hour



Additional Task (Training Provided)

You’ll also assist in preparing softcopy O&M Manuals using Microsoft Word templates.



A Plus, Not Essential

Experience with Revit (MEP) is not required but will be considered an advantage.

Working knowledge of the Construction Industry. 



Location

This is a remote role. You’ll need your own PC, equipment and software capable of running CAD software, plus a reliable internet connection and stable power. You’ll collaborate closely with team members based in the Philippines and Australia.



Skills Required

· Proficiency in AutoCAD

· Strong attention to detail

· Good English communication skills (verbal and written)

· Familiarity with Microsoft Word and Excel

· Own PC, equipment and software (including reliable internet and power)



Suitable For

This role suits someone re-entering the workforce, seeking flexible part-time work around other commitments, or currently employed and looking to supplement their income on their own schedule.



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:



1. One sample as built or construction CAD drawing from a recent project (with any confidential info redacted), or a screenshot of your layer/ CAD standards setup.



2. In 2–3 sentences: what layer naming convention or CAD standard did you use on that project, and what’s one thing about it you’d change if you were setting the standard yourself?



Applications without a sample drawing or layer screenshot won’t be considered.

title: Ecommerce Operations & Customer Support Specialist
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based ecommerce company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to join our team long-term.



This role involves **ecommerce operations, customer support, and working with company-provided software and AI-assisted tools.**



We already have a simple, established system in place. You will receive training and a clear daily workflow to follow.



This is **not a highly technical position**, and you do not need to be an advanced graphic designer. We are primarily looking for someone who learns quickly, communicates well, follows instructions, has strong attention to detail, and is friendly and helpful with customers.



# Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



Our company is continuing to grow, and for the right person there will be opportunities to:



* Take on more responsibility

* Learn additional parts of the business

* Move into a larger operations role

* Earn increased pay over time



We value dependable team members and want someone who is interested in growing with the company rather than simply working a short-term position.



# Work Schedule



This position is approximately **30 hours per week — 6 hours per day, Monday through Friday.**



The 6 hours are divided into **two 3-hour shifts each day**.



All scheduling is based on **U.S. Central Time (CT).**



You may select:



* **Any 3 consecutive hours between 5:00 AM and 12:00 PM Central Time**

* **Any 3 consecutive hours between 5:00 PM and 12:00 AM Central Time**



For applicants in the Philippines, these windows are currently approximately:



* U.S. morning window = **6:00 PM–1:00 AM Philippine Time**

* U.S. evening window = **6:00 AM–1:00 PM Philippine Time the following day**



The Philippine equivalent may shift by one hour when U.S. daylight saving time changes.



You will choose a consistent 3-hour shift within each window.



**You must be available for both a morning and evening U.S. Central Time shift.**



# What You’ll Be Doing



Most tasks are straightforward and repeatable. We already have systems, software, and step-by-step procedures in place.



Your daily work will mainly involve:



* Checking new customer orders

* Checking and responding to customer messages

* Providing friendly and professional customer service

* Following our internal order-processing system

* Using company-provided software and AI-assisted tools

* Preparing customer-facing order previews and materials

* Reviewing layouts for proper positioning and overall appearance

* Handling basic customer revisions and updates

* Following up with customers when necessary

* Updating order statuses

* Moving approved orders forward through our system

* Keeping internal records organized

* Completing general ecommerce operational tasks

* Following a simple daily checklist



You will not be expected to create your own process. We already have an established workflow that you will be trained to follow.



# What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable and consistent

* Friendly, patient, and helpful with customers

* Strong in written English

* Familiar with ecommerce

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to follow step-by-step procedures

* Organized and able to manage multiple orders

* Able to work independently after training

* Able to recognize when something looks visually incorrect, off-center, unbalanced, too large, or too small

* Professional when handling customer questions or revisions



Good visual judgment is important, but **advanced graphic-design experience is not required.**



## Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Ecommerce operations

* Customer support

* Order management

* Custom-product businesses

* Graphic or image-editing software

* AI tools

* Customer proofing or approval workflows



# Technology & AI



AI and technology will be part of your normal work.



You should be comfortable:



* Using AI tools

* Learning new software

* Following structured digital workflows

* Reviewing computer-generated outputs

* Recognizing when something does not look correct

* Making adjustments when necessary



All required company systems and procedures will be taught during training.



# Customer Support



Part of your role will involve communicating directly with customers.



This may include:



* Answering order-related questions

* Sending customer updates

* Handling basic revision requests

* Following up with customers

* Explaining information clearly and patiently

* Resolving basic issues in a helpful and professional manner



Strong written English, a friendly personality, and a genuine desire to help customers are important.



# Who Will Do Well Here?



You will likely be a strong fit if you:



* Notice small mistakes

* Learn software quickly

* Like organized and repeatable systems

* Are comfortable using AI

* Enjoy ecommerce

* Communicate clearly and kindly

* Follow instructions carefully

* Stay calm and professional with customers

* Take ownership of your work

* Can recognize whether something looks clean, centered, and professional



# How To Apply



Please answer **all** of the following:



1. Tell us about your previous ecommerce experience.

2. Which ecommerce platforms have you worked with?

3. Tell us about your customer-support experience.

4. How comfortable are you using AI tools?

5. What design or image-editing software have you used?

6. Have you worked for a custom-product or order-based ecommerce company before?

7. Which **3-hour morning CT shift** would you prefer?

8. Which **3-hour evening CT shift** would you prefer?

9. What is your desired weekly or monthly salary?

10. Tell us about a previous position where attention to detail was important.



**IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “ECOM OPS.”



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



We are looking for someone dependable, friendly, and customer-focused who wants a stable, long-term position with real opportunity for growth, increased responsibility, and higher pay over time.

title: Short-Form Video Research Assistant (TikTok & Instagram)
description:
We’re looking for a Short-Form Video Research Assistant for a one-week paid project, with the possibility of ongoing work.



Your main responsibility will be finding high-performing street interviews, street-interview ads, product reactions and public challenge videos across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



For each suitable video, you’ll add the following information to a structured Google Sheet:



• Original video link

• Platform and account name

• Visible views, likes, comments and shares

• Complete video transcript

• Opening hook

• Questions and follow-up questions

• Overall format and structure

• Product introduction, if applicable

• Strongest reaction or moment

• CTA or ending

• Presenter and editing style

• What makes the video effective

• How the format could be adapted for another product or brand

• Useful audience comments where relevant



You’ll be provided with clear instructions, completed examples, dropdown labels and a tracking template.



The ideal candidate:



• Understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and short-form content

• Has strong written English

• Is comfortable using Google Sheets and Google Drive

• Can follow detailed instructions accurately

• Has excellent attention to detail

• Can identify strong hooks, questions and storytelling

• Is comfortable using AI transcription tools

• Can work independently and check for duplicate videos



PAYMENT



• $160 fixed payment for the completed 40-hour week

• Additional $20 quality bonus available



The $20 quality bonus will be paid if:



• At least 150 suitable videos are properly tracked

• At least 90% of audited information is accurate

• Records are complete, organised and free from unnecessary duplicates

• Transcripts, hooks, questions and product introductions are correctly identified

• The completed spreadsheet and files are delivered by the agreed deadline



HOURS



• 40 hours across five days

• Eight hours per day

• Working hours can be flexible



WEEKLY TARGETS



• Minimum: 120 properly tracked videos

• Target: 150 properly tracked videos

• Stretch: 200 videos if accuracy remains high



Quality and accuracy are more important than reaching the stretch target. Incomplete, duplicated or inaccurately labelled records will not count towards the total.



This will begin as a one-week project. If your work is accurate, organised and thoughtful, there may be ongoing weekly or part-time work available.



TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Any relevant research, data-entry or social-media experience

3. Confirmation that you can complete 40 hours for $160

4. One street-interview video you think is creatively strong

5. Two or three sentences explaining why the video works



Begin your application with “VIDEO RESEARCH” so we know you have read the full description.

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

description:

Liminal Thread is an Australian-based business working predominantly within the dance industry.

We manage social media for dance businesses and brands across Australia, Canada and the US, alongside building our own brands and projects.



We're growing, and I'm looking for someone who can become a long-term part of the Liminal Thread team.

I will continue to lead strategy and create content for our social media management clients. Once I hand completed content over to you, I want to be able to forget about it.



You'll make sure content is scheduled or published on time, on the correct account, with the correct caption, tags, collaborators, links and other platform-specific requirements.



As you learn our brands and demonstrate strong creative judgement, there will also be opportunities to take on content creation for Liminal Thread's own brands.



This is a long-term role that I would love to grow alongside the business.
